character.aino.name: Aino
aliases: Parent of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop

facts.title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
facts.occupation: Inventor and mechanic; owner of the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
facts.identity_notes: A child (canon gives no age). Former member of the Conch Gang (affiliation listed for history only). Her parents are unknown.

character.albedo.name: Albedo
aliases: Chief Alchemist of the Knights of Favonius

facts.title: Kreideprinz
facts.species: Synthetic human created through the Art of Khemia
facts.occupation: Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius; illustrator under the pen name Calx
facts.identity_notes: Rhinedottir classified him as 'Cretaceus' (chalk, her highest-quality pedigree); he is 'Subject One' of her Primordial Human Project. He keeps an office at Knights of Favonius Headquarters but works mostly from his camp on Dragonspine. Since 6.2 he is a Hexerei character.

facts.title: Admonishing Instruction
facts.occupation: Scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya (formerly Acting Grand Sage)
facts.identity_notes: Haravatat graduate. Introduced as an NPC in 3.0, playable from 3.4 (event wish 'Caution in Confidence', 2023-01-18). Kaveh's Character Story 5 says Alhaitham is two years his junior; no age is stated.

facts.title: Savior From Another World
facts.species: Human (a clone, per her own account)
facts.occupation: Wandering hunter; adventurer with the Adventurers' Guild
facts.vision: Cryo (unique star-shaped design; how she obtained it is unknown)
facts.identity_notes: Crossover heroine from the Horizon series (Guerrilla Games), released 2.1 (PlayStation) and 2.2 (all platforms). Origin is another world, not a Teyvat nation; Genshin's profile calls her Outcast, hunter of machines, Seeker, Anointed and Savior. Her profile affiliation is 'Wandering Heroine'; second title 'Nora Huntress'.

facts.title: Swift-Striding Hound
facts.occupation: Hunter; odd jobs at the Korolevskiy Theater; covert Rokot member
facts.identity_notes: In story he fights with a much-modified hunting rifle handed down by his father; the game classes him as a polearm user. His Rokot codename is not given.

facts.title: Gliding Champion
facts.occupation: Outrider of the Knights of Favonius
facts.identity_notes: Her grandfather came from Liyue and married in Mondstadt, so she has Liyue ancestry. Her second profile title is 'Outrider'.

facts.title: Hanamizaka Heroics
facts.species: Oni (descendant of the Crimson Oni; the bloodline has thinned over generations)
facts.occupation: Head of the Arataki Gang; odd-job worker (transport, deliveries, drumming up customers)
facts.identity_notes: Second title: 'The First and Greatest Head of the Arataki Gang'. Invents a new 'Arataki "..." Itto' epithet constantly. Granny Oni is a human who raised him, not a relative.

facts.title: Dire Balemoon
facts.species: Human (descendant of Khaenri'ah's Crimson Moon Dynasty)
facts.occupation: Fourth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers; head of the House of the Hearth
facts.identity_notes: Birth name Peruere ('Perrie' to Clervie). 'Arlecchino' is the name the Tsaritsa bestowed with the codename The Knave. Raised in Fontaine and publicly calls herself Fontainian, but by blood she is of Khaenri'ah's Crimson Moon lineage; her actual birthplace and parents are unknown.

facts.title: Beyond Mortality
facts.occupation: Physician and owner of Bubu Pharmacy
facts.identity_notes: 'Mr. Bai' is a nickname that began with Qiqi's poor memory; his surname is not Bai. He is the current bearer of Changsheng's contract, which turned his eyes gold with slit pupils.

facts.title: Shining Idol
facts.occupation: Deaconess of the Church of Favonius; healer; singer and 'idol'
facts.identity_notes: Daughter of Seamus Pegg and Frederica Gunnhildr; raised by her father while Jean was raised by their mother. 'Barbara Pegg' is her official full name (anniversary hashflag); in-game she is simply Barbara.

facts.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
facts.occupation: Captain of the Crux, an armed merchant fleet
facts.identity_notes: 'Beidou' is the Chinese name of the Big Dipper; her flagship, the Alcor, is named after one of its stars. Her real name is unrevealed.

facts.title: Trial by Fire
facts.occupation: Adventurer; leader (and only member) of Benny's Adventure Team
facts.identity_notes: Raised in Mondstadt but born in Natlan to Macani (Collective of Plenty) and Aroni (Masters of the Night-Wind), revealed in 5.8. His name was given by his Guild 'dads'; his birth name, if any, is never given. In-game birthday is 29 February (28 February in non-leap years).

facts.title: Golden Vow
facts.occupation: Guardian of Aaru Village
facts.identity_notes: 'Descendant of King Deshret' (scion of Al-Ahmar) is a title for Aaru Village's people and its Guardians, not a literal claim of bloodline. Her father was an Akademiya scholar.

facts.title: Lens of Verity
facts.occupation: Reporter and photographer ('special correspondent') for The Steambird
facts.identity_notes: Daughter of the Steambird reporter and nature photographer Galanopoulo ('Reporter of the Idylls') and of Gagnepetit. Her Kamera, 'Monsieur Verite', is a heavily modified gift from her father.

facts.title: Skyborne Arbiter
facts.occupation: Peacemaker and Qucusaur rider
facts.identity_notes: Her birthday is the day Cusco's family adopted her, not her real birth date. She bears the Ancient Name Vuka ('Transcension'). In game she is a Bow user; in story her weapon is the gun Soulsniper: Ritual Staff, which she also rides.

character.chevreuse.name: Chevreuse
aliases: Special Security and Surveillance Patrol Captain

facts.title: Executor of Justice
facts.occupation: Captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol (Maison Gardiennage)
facts.identity_notes: In-game she is classed as a Polearm user, but in story she fights with a musket (a Special Patrol Type-II Standard Musket) used with bayonet and grenade attachments. Arkhe alignment: Ousia.

facts.title: The Thundering Seamstress
facts.occupation: Fashion designer; owner of Chioriya Boutique
facts.identity_notes: Born to a merchant family in Inazuma; settled in the Court of Fontaine, whose people named her 'The Thundering Seamstress' because she came from the land of thunder. Her in-game Vision case is Inazuman.

character.chongyun.name: Chongyun
aliases: Banisher of Evil and Rumors Thereof

facts.title: Frozen Ardor
facts.occupation: Exorcist (thaumaturge) of the Tianheng Thaumaturges
facts.identity_notes: Heir to a renowned Liyue exorcist family belonging to the Tianheng Thaumaturges (named in his 2022 birthday letter). Second in-game title: 'Banisher of Evil and Rumors Thereof'. Chinese name 重云 means 'layered clouds'.

facts.title: Obsidian Opalstar
facts.occupation: Great shaman and high priestess of the Masters of the Night-Wind
facts.identity_notes: Bears the Ancient Name Ukumbuko ('Memory'). 'Granny Itztli' is a nickname tied to her fearsome reputation; she claims to be 200, but that is only how long she has been counting.

facts.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
facts.occupation: Champion Duelist of the Court of Fontaine; Senior Game Master of the Tabletop Troupe
facts.identity_notes: Publicly she is only a Champion Duelist; her training as a Marechaussee Hunter is known to few, and she wishes to be remembered only as a duelist.

facts.title: Sprout of Rebirth
facts.occupation: Forest Ranger of Avidya Forest (a trainee until 6.6); Akademiya student
facts.identity_notes: Former Eleazar patient and Fatui test subject. Until 6.6 she carried a sealed fragment of Nabu Malikata's remains; Liloupar removed it. Her pre-Sumeru story is told in the official manga.

facts.title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
facts.occupation: Moon Goddess; former Third Harbinger
facts.identity_notes: Born Kuutar 400-500 years ago; Fatui codenames Columbina and The Damselette; chose the full name Columbina Hyposelenia ('born beneath the moon') in 6.2. Her 'Hydro' is a gameplay label: her power is lunar (Light Realm) energy.

facts.title: Judicator of Secrets
facts.species: Human (desert-dweller); vessel of Hermanubis's Ba fragments
facts.occupation: General Mahamatra (head of the Matra) of the Sumeru Akademiya
facts.identity_notes: A desert-born child adopted and raised in the Akademiya by the Spantamad sage Cyrus. Briefly resigned as General Mahamatra during the 3.1 crisis and was reinstated after the sages fell (3.2). Under Bamoun's will he inherited leadership of the Temple of Silence in 4.6 and handed it to Sethos.

facts.title: Ode and Oblation
facts.occupation: Deacon of the Church of Favonius, choir cantor and Herald of Barbatos
facts.identity_notes: His secondary title is 'Herald of Barbatos'. Profile text calls him a young man ('a youth blessed by gods'); no age is given.

facts.title: Flame-Mane
facts.occupation: Eremite mercenary (bodyguard, escort, desert guide)
facts.identity_notes: Raised by Kusayla of Dakan Al-Ahmar as his daughter; his posthumous letter (3.5) reveals he found her abandoned in the desert. Her birth parents are unknown. Her second profile title is 'Unfettered Desert Mercenary'.

facts.title: The Dark Side of Dawn
facts.occupation: Owner of the Dawn Winery and its tavern Angel's Share; secret vigilante
facts.identity_notes: Head of the Ragnvindr Clan; formerly Cavalry Captain of the Knights of Favonius; secretly the 'Darknight Hero' and the Northern Intelligence Network contact codenamed 'Owl'.

facts.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
facts.species: Human of the Kätzlein bloodline (cat ears and tail)
facts.occupation: Bartender of the Cat's Tail; huntress
facts.identity_notes: A young girl; no age is given in canon. Her father Draff is a distant descendant of Olaf, a Kätzlein hunter frozen for three hundred years. The wiki treats Herne, a young NPC who calls Draff 'Uncle', as her cousin.

facts.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
facts.occupation: Merchant; owner of the Palace of Alcazarzaray, merchant caravans, a commerce guild and Dori's Divine Bazaar
facts.identity_notes: 'Lord Sangemah Bay' is her trade name and the title her staff use; many clients (Kaveh included) did not know the 'Lord' was Dori until they met her.

facts.title: The Undying Fire
facts.identity_notes: Shares his name with Rhinedottir's Abyssal dragon Durin, slain by Dvalin in the cataclysm; this entry covers both. He was 'Mini Durin' (named by Alice) from 4.8 until his human transformation in 5.6. Hexerei character since 6.2.

facts.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
facts.occupation: Forensic cleaner (independent contractor) and perfumer
facts.identity_notes: Independent contractor with a long-standing work agreement with the Gardes; also takes private cleanup commissions. Not employed by the Confrerie of Cabriere or any perfume brand. Pneuma-aligned in gameplay.

facts.title: Tasteful Excellence
facts.occupation: Chef; former head chef of the Hotel Debord; Furina's Patissiere Supreme
facts.identity_notes: Former inmate of the Fortress of Meropide after taking responsibility for a lumiline contamination at the Hotel Debord. Based at a tavern kitchen by the Fleuve Cendre.

facts.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
facts.occupation: Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company
facts.identity_notes: Eldest daughter of the present-day Lawrence Clan and bearer of its Glacial Seal; estranged from the clan, which calls her a traitor. 'Spindrift Knight' comes from her bone whistle's imitation of ocean waves, not from Hydro. Called the Captain of the 4th Company in Paralogism; the Reconnaissance Company elsewhere.

facts.title: Enigmatic Machinist
facts.occupation: Haravatat researcher and adviser at the Sumeru Akademiya (ruin texts and ancient mechanisms)
facts.identity_notes: Born over a century ago; physically unaged because a ruin held her body in stasis for about a hundred years. Her exact age is never given. She insists on being addressed as 'Madam Faruzan'.

facts.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
facts.occupation: Investigator for the Adventurers' Guild
facts.identity_notes: Her birth name is Amy (official announcements; Character Stories 4-5). She took the name Fischl from her favourite novel series, which her father then used for her. She became an investigator at fourteen; her current age is not given.

facts.title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
facts.occupation: Ratnik (Lightkeeper); lighthouse keeper
facts.identity_notes: Full name Kyryll Chudomirovich Flins; legend remembers the vanished noble as Kyryll the Azure Flame. His true form is a blue flame.

character.freminet.name: Freminet
aliases: Renowned Diver of the Court of Fontaine

facts.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
facts.occupation: Diver and mechanic; member of the House of the Hearth
facts.identity_notes: Youngest of the House of the Hearth trio; adopted sibling, not blood relative, of the twins Lyney and Lynette. No surname is given.

character.furina.name: Furina
aliases: Regina of All Waters, Kindreds, Peoples and Laws

facts.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
facts.species: Human (the body and spirit Focalors separated from her divinity)
facts.occupation: Actress, film director and artistic consultant (Musketeer Pictures); formerly the public face of the Hydro Archon
facts.identity_notes: Publicly ruled as 'Focalors, the Hydro Archon' under the regnal title Regina of All Waters, Kindreds, Peoples and Laws, but never held the Divine Throne, the Hydro Authority or the Gnosis. She existed for roughly five centuries (the wiki counts 499 years). Her Hydro Vision appeared in 4.2's 'The Little Oceanid'.

facts.title: Leonine Vanguard
facts.occupation: Escort guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency; head of the Mighty Mythical Beasts Wushou troupe
facts.identity_notes: Name is romanised from Cantonese (Yip Gaming); 'Gaming' is his given name, not a reference to games. Second title: 'Sword and Strongbox' Transport Guard.

facts.title: Plenilune Gaze
facts.species: Half-human, half-qilin (illuminated beast); counted among the adepti
facts.occupation: General secretary of the Liyue Qixing at Yuehai Pavilion
facts.identity_notes: Thousands of years old; she fought in the Archon War. Her qilin heritage is little known in Liyue Harbor, and she passes her horns off as an heirloom hair ornament.

facts.title: Canine Warrior
facts.species: Human with canine ears and tail (canon does not explain the heritage)
facts.occupation: General of the Watatsumi Army; anonymous advice columnist for Yae Publishing House
facts.identity_notes: 'Gorou' is traditionally a name for a fifth son, and Kujou Sara has heard he is one. His troops call him 'Top Dog' and the 'ever-victorious pointy-eared general'. 'Ms. Hina' is a pen name Yae Miko attached to his column without telling him.

character.hu-tao.name: Hu Tao
aliases: 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor

facts.title: Fragrance in Thaw
facts.occupation: 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor; amateur poet
facts.identity_notes: Hu is her family name and Tao her given name; unlike most early characters, she goes by her full name in official material. She inherited the Staff of Homa, the Hu Family's ceremonial polearm.

facts.title: Tempered in Molten Stone
facts.occupation: Head fitness coach and nutritionist
facts.identity_notes: Ancient Name Uwezo ('Power'), previously held by Wanjiru. An adult; she is short, not a child.

facts.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
facts.occupation: Sauro-vet with his own clinic
facts.identity_notes: His secondary in-game title is 'Tlalocan Vet' and his profile lists the affiliation 'Tlalocan'. He was seventeen when his parents died; his present age is never stated.

facts.title: Nightmare's Burning Heart
facts.occupation: Squad Leader of the Lightkeepers' investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles; Lightkeeper representative in the League
facts.identity_notes: Pronounced roughly 'EET-loo-uh'. Described as the youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers. Canon gives no age.

facts.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
facts.occupation: Household robot
facts.identity_notes: 'Ineffa' is both her model name and her individual name, since she is the only finished unit. Her core derives from Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk, the Eleventh Sovereign Lord (the wiki infobox gives her 'real name' as "Ix Raq'lapuj Chue'q Buluk Ch'ule-L"); she is a separate being, not the Eleventh Lord. The wiki lists the Thirteen Sovereign Lords as a former affiliation, through her core.

facts.title: Windthreading Shadow
facts.occupation: Official employee of the Curatorium of Secrets (errands, commissions, intel); former thief of the Seahook Gang
facts.identity_notes: She does not remember her hometown and does not care where it was. Fragum is Latin for 'strawberry', and 'jahoda' is the Czech and Slovak word for it. Her right arm is a mechanical prosthesis.

facts.title: Dandelion Knight
facts.occupation: Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius
facts.identity_notes: Heir of the Gunnhildr Clan through her mother; daughter of Seamus Pegg and older sister of Barbara. Formerly a squad captain, then Master of the Knights; Acting Grand Master since Varka's departure and still so titled after his return.

facts.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
facts.species: Human (Natlanese); pika-like ears and a short tail, seen in her tribe as an 'atavistic trait'
facts.occupation: Warrior of the Children of Echoes; Ancient Name bearer; gem digger
facts.identity_notes: Ancient Name: Uthabiti (toughness, tenacity). Also titled 'Nanatzcayan Young Braveheart'; Nanatzcayan is the native name of the Children of Echoes.

facts.title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
facts.occupation: Wandering samurai; temporary crew member of the Crux Fleet
facts.identity_notes: Last heir of the Kaedehara Clan, once a noble samurai family and leading house of the Isshin Art in the Raiden Gokaden. Ancestry includes the Niwa Clan through his adopted great-grandfather. His Watatsumi Army membership is former.

facts.title: Frostwind Swordsman
facts.occupation: Cavalry Captain of the Knights of Favonius
facts.identity_notes: Adopted son of Crepus Ragnvindr and adoptive brother of Diluc; by birth a member of Khaenri'ah's Alberich Clan, whose ancestors served as regents after King Irmin and (per Dainsleif) founded the Abyss Order. The Ragnvindr household still calls him 'Master Kaeya'.

facts.title: Frostflake Heron
facts.occupation: Manages the Kamisato Clan's internal and external affairs for the Yashiro Commission
facts.identity_notes: Japanese-style name order: Kamisato is the family name. 'Shirasagi Himegimi' (White Heron Princess) is a popular honorific whose origin nobody can pin down.

facts.title: Pillar of Fortitude
facts.occupation: Yashiro Commissioner; head of the Kamisato Clan; commander of the Shuumatsuban
facts.identity_notes: Family name first (Japanese order). His father, never named in canon, died when Ayato was young; his mother Kamisato Kayo died soon after. Canon gives no age, only 'young but highly accomplished'.

facts.title: Empyrean Reflection
facts.occupation: Independent architect and designer
facts.identity_notes: Kshahrewar graduate with honours, called the Light of Kshahrewar; secondary title Renowned Sumeru Architect. Runs his own studio. First mentioned in 3.0 voice-overs, first seen in 3.2, playable from 3.6 (2023-05-02).

facts.title: Driving Thunder
facts.occupation: Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing, responsible for land, real estate and construction
facts.identity_notes: Yuheng is the title of her Qixing seat (named for a star of the Big Dipper). She comes from an illustrious Liyue family; her late grandfather was a real estate tycoon and scholar of tradition.

facts.title: Turnfire Hunt
facts.occupation: Saurian Hunter, tribal courier and paid troubleshooter
facts.identity_notes: Bearer of the Ancient Name Malipo ('Turnfire', also 'cost'); one of Natlan's six modern heroes.

facts.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
facts.species: Youkai (nekomata); originally an ordinary one-tailed cat
facts.occupation: Gold Level Courier, Komaniya Express (sole international courier)
facts.identity_notes: Her birthday is the day she became a youkai, not the day she was born. Granny named her Kirara. 'Nekomata-in-Boots' was her fairy-tale role in Simulanka (4.8); 'Cat in a Box' is how Durin perceived her.

character.klee.name: Klee
aliases: Red Knight of the Stormbearer Mountains

facts.title: Fleeing Sunlight
facts.occupation: Spark Knight of the Knights of Favonius
facts.identity_notes: A young child; canon gives no age. Daughter of Alice and the 'Seeker' Kleiner. Hexerei character since completing her Witch's Homework (6.2).

facts.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
facts.occupation: General of the Tenryou Commission
facts.identity_notes: Takayuki named her 'Sara' when he adopted her; before that she had neither given name nor surname. Her birth family is unknown apart from Yae Miko's remark about her tengu father.

character.kuki-shinobu.name: Kuki Shinobu
aliases: Deputy Leader of the Arataki Gang

facts.title: Mender of Tribulations
facts.occupation: Deputy leader of the Arataki Gang; freelance consultant holding many professional certifications
facts.identity_notes: Kuki is the family name (Japanese name order). A member of the Kuki Clan, a family of shrine maidens serving the Grand Narukami Shrine; formerly a trainee shrine maiden there. First mentioned in a 2.0 voice-over (localised then as 'Kuki Ninja'); appeared in person in 2.7.

facts.title: Spring Woven From Jade
facts.occupation: Master rattan weaver of the Chenyu Vale Artisans Association; hobbyist Qimen thaumaturge of the Lan clan
facts.identity_notes: Belongs to the Lan clan of Chenyu Vale, which descends from the brothers of the Wind Reader Lan Junming (he had no children). Affiliations not covered by archive ids: Chenyu Vale Artisans Association, Lan clan.

facts.title: Evermoon's Sacrament Song
facts.species: Human (Frostmoon Scion of the old Hyperborean bloodline: antlers, silver blood, kuuvahki sensitivity)
facts.occupation: Moonchanter (spiritual leader) of the Frostmoon Scions
facts.vision: none (wields a Dendro Moon Wheel she has had since birth)
facts.identity_notes: 'Maiden of the Grove' is her second profile title. As a child she was hailed as the 'Frostmoon's Emissary' and 'Moon-Tide Maiden'. Her people call her Lady Moonchanter or Lady Lauma. Canon gives no family name.

facts.title: Fantastical Evening Star
facts.occupation: Rtawahist student (Theoretical Astrology) at the Sumeru Akademiya
facts.identity_notes: Her sleepwalking self is not a separate person: it calls itself Layla and calls her 'Daylight Layla'. The Traveler nicknamed it 'Dreamwalker Layla' (5.7). As the 'Wisdom Seelie' it answered students' questions at the House of Daena (3.6 hangout).

facts.title: Augur of Wonders
facts.occupation: Naturalist; Adventurers' Guild advisor
facts.vision: none (innate fae power; carries a Geo Moon Wheel)
facts.identity_notes: Born to an unnamed Augury Bird couple who live in the Snezhnayan tundra and raised in Nod-Krai by the human couple Latkin and Zinovia, who called her 'Lili'. A former leader of the Conch Gang (she left on growing up). Second title: Advisor for the Adventurers' Guild.

facts.title: Witch of Purple Rose
facts.occupation: Librarian of the Knights of Favonius; also responsible for the Knights' potion supply
facts.identity_notes: Formerly a student of the Spantamad Darshan at the Sumeru Akademiya (two years, under the sage Cyrus). 'Witch of Purple Rose' is her own title; 'The Librarian' is her official introduction title.

facts.title: Sharpened Arrowhead
facts.occupation: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius 5th Company (Ranged)
facts.identity_notes: Former adventurer (Adventurers' Guild membership is past). Son of a family of bowmakers. Mostly stationed at the Knights of Favonius Base in Dornman Port. Hexerei character after his Witch's Homework.

facts.title: Elegance in the Shadows
facts.species: Human (with inherited cat ears and tail through atavism)
facts.occupation: Magician's assistant at Hotel Bouffes d'ete; House of the Hearth intelligence agent
facts.identity_notes: Lyney's younger twin and Freminet's adoptive older sister. Her cat ears and tail are real, not costume. 'Multi-Function Magic Assistant' is her self-description.

character.lyney.name: Lyney
aliases: Celebrated Magician of the Court of Fontaine

facts.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
facts.occupation: Stage magician; House of the Hearth field agent
facts.identity_notes: Elder twin of Lynette and eldest of the House sibling trio with Freminet. No surname or numeric age is given in canon; he has been in the House for over ten years.

facts.title: Night-Igniting Flame
facts.occupation: Pyro Archon and leader of Natlan
facts.vision: Pyro Vision received in childhood; current status unknown. As Archon she holds the Pyro Authority (no Gnosis since 6.6)
facts.identity_notes: Born into the Scions of the Canopy about five hundred years ago; Haborym is the divine name carried by Natlan's Pyro Archons, and Kiongozi ('leader') is her Ancient Name.

facts.title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
facts.occupation: Front-Line Land Surveyor of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company
facts.identity_notes: Second son of the Schmidt family; Huffman's younger brother. Canon calls him young and says Lohen is around his age, but gives no number. The constellation name Palumbus means 'wood pigeon'.

facts.title: Astral Reflection
facts.occupation: Astrologist (hydromancer); columnist for The Steambird's 'All Things Astrological'
facts.identity_notes: 'Megistus' ('great') is a school name Barbeloth gave her on taking her as a pupil, not a family surname; her original surname is not given. The full name is rendered several ways in game ('Astrologist Mona Megistus', 'Mona Megistus, the Astrologist').

facts.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
facts.occupation: Guide; watersports shop owner
facts.identity_notes: Bears the Ancient Name Umoja ('unity'), once Tupac's. Meztli is her tribe's own name.

facts.title: Physic of Purity
facts.species: God (Archon) made from Irminsul's purest branch
facts.occupation: Dendro Archon of Sumeru
facts.identity_notes: Buer is her divine name, Lesser Lord Kusanali her regnal title, Nahida the name she goes by. She looks like a child but is a god about five hundred years old (by the original history); she must always be portrayed non-sexually.

character.navia.name: Navia
aliases: President of the Spina di Rosula

facts.title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
facts.occupation: President of the Spina di Rosula
facts.identity_notes: Surname Caspar confirmed by an NPC; she rarely uses it. 'Boss' and 'Demoiselle' are what Spina members call her. Her Arkhe alignment is Ousia.

character.nefer.name: Nefer
aliases: Owner of the Curatorium of Secrets

facts.title: Secret Beneath the Sands
facts.occupation: Owner of the Curatorium of Secrets; representative (head) of the Northern Intelligence Network
facts.identity_notes: Adopted daughter of the Shimti chief Sinuhe; her birth origins are unknown. Formerly of Aaru Village and the Akademiya's Vahumana Darshan.

facts.title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
facts.species: Hydro Dragon Sovereign, reborn in human form
facts.occupation: Iudex (Chief Justice) of Fontaine; since 4.2 also administers the nation
facts.identity_notes: Goes only by his surname; no one in Fontaine knows his first name. Fontainians have long guessed he is a Hydro Archon familiar or a Hydro elemental being; few know he is the Hydro Dragon.

facts.title: Clamor Within
facts.species: Former angel of Celestia, now near-human
facts.occupation: Hexenzirkel mage; guide and prophetess; sculptor; aspiring novelist
facts.identity_notes: Codename 'N' in the Hexenzirkel. Formerly an angel sent by the Heavenly Principles to Hyperborea; after the war of funerary flame she gave up half her wisdom and power and her voice to keep a human form. Physically mute: she speaks telepathically. Her Pyro Vision came much later, recognising her 'as human'.

facts.title: Dance of Lotuslight
facts.occupation: Lead dancer of the Zubayr Theater
facts.identity_notes: Also titled 'Star of Zubayr Theater'. Her parents and her dance teacher are never named.

facts.title: Eclipsing Star
facts.occupation: Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing (law and foreign relations); merchant magnate
facts.identity_notes: Her second profile title is 'Lady of the Jade Chamber & Her Eminence, the Tianquan'. Her Vision was a masterless one she meant to auction; it awoke in her hands.

facts.title: Chivalric Blossom
facts.occupation: Maid of the Knights of Favonius; aspiring (not yet selected) knight
facts.identity_notes: Her second in-game title is 'Maid of Favonius'; Mondstadters call her the 'Wondermaid'. As of 7.1 she is still not formally a knight.

character.odette.name: Odette
aliases: Prima Ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe

facts.title: Swirling Snow
facts.occupation: Prima ballerina of the Korolevskiy Troupe; Fatui operative
facts.identity_notes: Her Rokot codename 'Lelek' was exposed in 7.0 and has been permanently withdrawn. She is suspended from the Rokot and may later take a new codename. She remains a Fatuus and the rumoured favourite to inherit Signora's title.

facts.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
facts.species: Human (born with an incomplete soul; bat-like ears)
facts.occupation: Farmer and Phlogiston Aphid keeper; volunteer reader and organiser of his tribe's old texts
facts.identity_notes: Ancient Name: Bidii ('devotion'). Canon calls him a young man in his twenties without a precise age. 'Ororon' was written on his swaddling cloth; its meaning is unknown. Second title: Shrouded Bat of Mictlan. Briefly worked with the Fatui (wiki lists him as a 'collaborator').

facts.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
facts.occupation: Child; self-proclaimed Witch Hunter
facts.identity_notes: A child. Canon gives no exact age; Descartes appeared 'when I was about four or five', and Alice jokes that she argues like a 16-year-old in a debate set for 12-year-olds. Member of the Little Hexenzirkel (Klee's children's club), not of the real Hexenzirkel.

facts.title: Icy Resurrection
facts.species: Human revived as a zombie (Liyue jiangshi-style undead) by adeptal energy
facts.occupation: Apprentice, pharmacist and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy
facts.identity_notes: Died centuries ago and was revived by the adepti; 'alive' here means active and undead. Her body looks frozen at the age of her death, so estimates of her age are unreliable. Her adeptus name is Fortune Preserver, which she does not remember.

facts.title: Plane of Euthymia
facts.species: God, housed in a puppet body
facts.occupation: Shogun (ruler) of Inazuma
facts.identity_notes: Ei (divine name Beelzebul) lives in the Plane of Euthymia inside her sword and shares the puppet body with the Shogun; publicly she rules as Baal, the Raiden Shogun.

facts.title: Wolf Boy
facts.occupation: Hunter living with the Wolvendom wolf pack
facts.identity_notes: Abandoned or lost as an infant (circumstances unknown) and raised by Boreas's pack. Canon calls him a boy; no age is given.

facts.title: Thorny Benevolence
facts.occupation: Sister of the Church of Favonius; covert investigator and enforcer for the Church
facts.identity_notes: Born in a remote mountain village outside Mondstadt (unnamed), raised by the bandits who destroyed it. Her second profile title is 'A Nonconforming Sister'.

character.sandrone.name: Sandrone
aliases: The Seventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers
Her Highness the Clockwork Princess, Unraveller of All Reason

facts.title: Mirrored Analysis
facts.species: Automaton (a puppet built by Alain Guillotin, with an emotion module)
facts.occupation: Seventh Fatui Harbinger; head of the Armory Palace; joint overseer of the Adventurers' Guild; Veche member
facts.vision: Stellar Linchpin (Cryo), manifested at her revival
facts.identity_notes: 'Marionette' is both the name Alain first gave her and, by coincidence, the Tsaritsa's Harbinger title for her. 'Sandrone' began as a codename and became what her friends call her. Alain's letter calls her his 'little Clockwork Princess'; the long self-styled title comes from an embarrassing early diary page.

facts.title: Pearl of Wisdom
facts.occupation: Divine Priestess and supreme leader of Watatsumi Island
facts.identity_notes: Current heir of the Sangonomiya bloodline, hence Divine Priestess. Japanese name order: Sangonomiya is the family name. Her pen name 'Sole of the Deep' is mentioned in game; her second title is 'Hibernating Homebody Strategist'.

facts.title: Mujina Ninja
facts.occupation: Ninja of the Shuumatsuban (Yashiro Commission)
facts.identity_notes: Last successor of the Yoohoo Art school of ninjutsu. Raised in the Shuumatsuban from early childhood; supervised by the shrine maiden Kano Nana. Canon keeps her exact age ambiguous.

facts.title: Wisdom's Measure
facts.species: Human (desert-dweller); former vessel of a Ba fragment of Hermanubis
facts.occupation: Leader of the Temple of Silence; poses in Sumeru City as an ordinary errand-runner, desert guide and caravan helper
facts.identity_notes: Adoptive grandson of Bamoun, the Temple of Silence's previous leader. Gave his Ba fragment to Cyno in the 4.6 Rite of Duels and was then appointed leader by Cyno, who as holder of both fragments had inherited the post under Bamoun's last wish. In Sumeru City he hides this behind an invented, ordinary family background.

facts.title: Lonesome Transcendence
facts.occupation: Adeptus's disciple; server at Wanmin Restaurant
facts.identity_notes: Born into a branch family of the Tianheng Thaumaturges exorcist clan (Chongyun's clan) in a now-abandoned village on Mt. Tianheng. Not an adeptus, though often taken for one; her hair turned white when she took Cloud Retainer's jade-comb apprenticeship rite. Second title: Ethereal Soul Amidst the Mortal Realm.

facts.title: Analytical Harmony
facts.occupation: Doushin and special detective of the Tenryou Commission's Police Station
facts.identity_notes: Japanese name order (surname Shikanoin). Co-founder of what is now the Bantan Sango Detective Agency, originally 'Bantan Sango & Heizou Detective Agency'. A Catalyst user in game, but fights with his fists and kicks.

facts.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
facts.species: Melusine (born of the dragon Elynas), with human-like face and hands
facts.occupation: Head Nurse of the Fortress of Meropide
facts.identity_notes: A Melusine, not part-human. Long ago she took a potion that gave her a human face, hands and feet. Her Melusine ears, tail and back fins remain. Canon gives no age, only that she served her sentence 'hundreds of years ago'.

facts.title: Void Star
facts.occupation: Wandering swordswoman
facts.vision: none (Abyssal power disguised as Cryo by the Seven-Shifting Serpent technique)
facts.identity_notes: Born on an unnamed, now-dead planet in the sea of stars. Her wiki affiliation is the 'Cosmic Calamity', the name other civilizations give to Surtalogi and those linked to him. Second title: "Sinner's Pupil, Fool's Master" (pupil of a Sinner of Khaenri'ah, master of the Harbinger 'Childe'). She says Surtalogi sent her into Teyvat several hundred years ago. Her playable model is taller than other medium female characters.

facts.title: Harmless Sweetie
facts.species: Unknown; a Mondstadter with hereditary animal-like ears
facts.occupation: Bio-alchemist; Assistant Alchemist to Albedo (Investigation Team, Knights of Favonius)
facts.identity_notes: Works for the Knights of Favonius but is not a knight. Her animal-like ears are hereditary; what animal they resemble is unknown, even to her.

character.tartaglia.name: Tartaglia
aliases: Eleventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers

facts.title: Childe
facts.occupation: Eleventh of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers; councilor of the Snezhnograd Veche representing the Fatui armed forces
facts.identity_notes: Birth name Ajax (no surname given), after a hero of a Snezhnayan tale. 'Tartaglia' and 'Childe' are his Harbinger names. Teucer is the only family member who does not know he is a Harbinger.

facts.title: Protector From Afar
facts.occupation: Housekeeper of the Kamisato Clan; 'fixer' for the Yashiro Commission
facts.identity_notes: Son of an unnamed Inazuman father and the Mondstadt Knight Ulrike; raised in Mondstadt, he has lived in Inazuma for over ten years. First appeared as an NPC in the 2.0 Archon Quest; playable from 2.2.

facts.title: Verdant Strider
facts.species: Human with inherited Tighnarian (Valuka Shuna) traits: large fox-like ears and a tail
facts.occupation: Forest Watcher and leader of the Forest Rangers; botanist and Amurta graduate
facts.identity_notes: Also called 'Avidya Forest Watcher'. The rangers once nicknamed him 'General Watchleader'; he made them go back to 'Forest Watcher', 'Master' or 'Mr. Tighnari'. Collei calls him 'Master Tighnari'.

facts.title: Descender
facts.occupation: Traveler
facts.identity_notes: The player picks which twin is the Traveler; the other becomes the lost sibling. The player may also choose a nickname, but the sibling always uses the real name, and the twins are the only ones who call each other Aether and Lumine. Birthday is set by the player. In-game body model: medium male (Aether) or medium female (Lumine). Far older than they look: they had already wandered the stars for an immense time before arriving in Teyvat about 500 years ago.

facts.title: Strength in Serenity
facts.species: Human (Natlanese), with horns, cow-like ears and a tail
facts.occupation: Orchard manager; Patrol Team warrior
facts.identity_notes: Profile subtitle: 'Stalwart Warrior and Orchard Owner from the Collective of Plenty'. Children call her the 'Masked Hero'. Quests call her a young woman; no age is given.

character.varka.name: Varka
aliases: Grand Master Who Rivals the Gods

facts.title: Knight of Boreas
facts.occupation: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius; Knight of Boreas
facts.identity_notes: Named in voice-overs since 1.0; voice only in 5.6; first on screen in 6.1 (Song of the Welkin Moon Act III); playable from 6.4 (Luna V, 2026-02-25). 'Wolf of the North' can mean either him or Boreas.

facts.title: Windborne Bard
facts.species: God; once an Anemo wind spirit
facts.occupation: Anemo Archon living as a wandering bard
facts.vision: none (fake glass Vision; Gnosis taken by Signora)
facts.identity_notes: Barbatos is his divine name; 'Venti' is the persona he lives under and, as a 6.3 artifact text strongly implies, the name of the dead friend whose form he took.

facts.title: Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade
facts.occupation: Commander-in-chief of the Druzhna
facts.identity_notes: Daughter of Grand Duchess Benigna and granddaughter of Pyotr, reigning Grand Duke of the Vila. Called 'that little lass from House Strivozha' as a recruit. Her Anemo comes from a Stellar Linchpin, not a Vision.

character.vodyanitsa.name: Vodyanitsa
aliases: Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe

facts.title: Lingering Siren-Song
facts.occupation: Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe; Rokot member; manager of the Rankova Zorya station renovation
facts.identity_notes: Centuries old: she was a small child during Snezhnaya's human-fae civil war, which Valeriy dates to over four hundred years ago, early in the Tsaritsa's reign. Canon gives no exact age. Her parents were Water Imp nobles.

facts.title: Eons Adrift
facts.species: Puppet (made by Ei from Irminsul wood)
facts.occupation: Vahumana student; Nahida's covert assistant
facts.identity_notes: He has no birth name; Ei never named him. 'Kabukimono' was a Tatarasuna nickname, 'Scaramouche' and 'The Balladeer' his Fatui name and codename, 'Kunikuzushi' a name he took for himself, and 'Shouki no Kami' the false-god title. The player names him in As Though Morning Dew; most characters call him 'Hat Guy', his Akademiya enrollment name. His profile lists no affiliation.

facts.species: Manekin: an artificial, doll-like avatar (exact nature not stated)
facts.occupation: Avatar for exploring the Miliastra Wonderland
facts.vision: none (no Vision; element follows the Traveler's)
facts.identity_notes: One playable entry covering two avatars, Manekin (male) and Manekina (female). The player names them, and they have no fixed face, outfit or personality. Each has three selectable voices that share the same few lines. The body is fully customisable (male Manekin, female Manekina). The Chinese name 奇域人偶 means roughly 'Wonderland doll'.

character.wriothesley.name: Wriothesley
aliases: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide

facts.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
facts.occupation: Prison administrator (honorary title: Duke)
facts.identity_notes: 'Wriothesley' is a name he chose for himself in hospital after the killing, taken from an old person's obituary; the name his foster parents gave him is never revealed. His official birthday is the day his sentence was recorded.

facts.title: Exquisite Delicacy
facts.occupation: Head chef (and waitress) of the Wanmin Restaurant
facts.identity_notes: Surname Mao comes from an official anniversary hashflag (#XianglingMao) and her father's name, Chef Mao. Canon calls her 'still young' but gives no age. 'Madam Xiangling' is what Beidou ordered the Crux to call her.

facts.title: Passerine Herald
facts.species: Adeptus (illuminated beast; true form a crane)
facts.occupation: Adeptus and inventor of mechanisms; new resident of Liyue Harbor
facts.vision: Anemo (worn by choice; she does not need it)
facts.identity_notes: Cloud Retainer is her adeptus name; 'Xianyun' ('leisurely clouds') is the human name she took in 4.4.

facts.title: Vigilant Yaksha
facts.species: Adeptus (illuminated beast of the yaksha kind)
facts.occupation: Guardian Yaksha who purges demonic remnants of fallen gods
facts.identity_notes: 'Xiao' is a protective name given by Morax; 'Alatus' (Chinese Jinpeng) is his Yaksha name, which he says means swiftness/nimbleness. His true name is never given. Character stories say he is 'something over two thousand years' old.

facts.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
facts.occupation: Smith and Name Engraver
facts.identity_notes: Bears the Ancient Name Baraka ('blessing'), first borne by Ixquieh, founder of the Children of Echoes; one of the six modern Heroes of Natlan. 'Nanatzcayan Smith' is her second wiki title; Nanatzcayan is the tribe's native name.

facts.title: Juvenile Galant
facts.occupation: Merchant family's second son; swordsman; novelist
facts.identity_notes: His real name is used openly; 'Zhenyu' is his pen name with Yae Publishing House (some pre-2.2 text called it 'Chenqiu'). He competed as 'Hong'yu' in a card-game event. He is a teenager or young man; canon gives no age.

facts.title: Blazing Riff
facts.occupation: Rock 'n' roll musician, songwriter and instrument-maker
facts.identity_notes: Her profile lists her affiliation as "The Red Strings", which canon text never explains. Character stories call her tall, taller than most girls, but give no figure. 'Xingyan' is only a cover name Yun Jin uses with her troupe's elders.

character.yae-miko.name: Yae Miko
aliases: Fried Tofu with All the Frills

facts.title: Astute Amusement
facts.occupation: Guuji (head priestess) of the Grand Narukami Shrine; owner and editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House
facts.vision: Electro (she teases that it might be 'purely ornamental'; never clarified)
facts.identity_notes: Calls herself Ei's familiar and servant. Canon gives no age: she was 'a young kitsune' at the time of the cataclysm five hundred years ago and has since become a great youkai.

facts.title: Wise Innocence
facts.occupation: Legal adviser (Yanfei Legal Consultancy)
facts.identity_notes: Half-illuminated beast who never signed Rex Lapis's contract; her only lifelong contract is with her parents, to 'live happily'. Canon gives no age; she is an adult professional whom Ganyu knew as a child.

facts.title: Burgeoning Grace
facts.occupation: Youngest disciple of the adeptus Streetward Rambler (Madame Ping)
facts.identity_notes: A mortal child, not an adeptus. Her home is a secluded farmstead near Qingce Village; she lives with her master in Liyue Harbor and goes home for festivals. Canon gives no age; a Character Story says she is about half an adult's height.

facts.title: Valley Orchid
facts.occupation: Intelligence officer reporting to the Tianquan; nominal Ministry of Civil Affairs employee; secret owner of Yanshang Teahouse
facts.identity_notes: Uses many disguises and names. Most Ministry staff have never heard of her and her name is on no roster. Her home lies in a quiet area outside Liyue Harbor; canon gives no family name and no age.

facts.title: Frolicking Flames
facts.occupation: Pyrotechnician; owner of Naganohara Fireworks
facts.identity_notes: Naganohara is the family name (Japanese name order). Profile title 'Frolicking Flames'; also titled Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Her father Naganohara Ryuunosuke ran the shop before her; her mother is unnamed.

facts.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
facts.occupation: Clinical psychologist; core founding investor and major shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse
facts.identity_notes: Several centuries old: she was a young baku before the Cataclysm 500 years ago and says she has worked with nightmares for centuries. No exact age is given. Her human form is a choice; she says a baku's appearance reflects personality more than age.

facts.title: Stage Lucida
facts.occupation: Director of the Yun-Han Opera Troupe; Liyue opera singer and playwright
facts.identity_notes: Heir of the house of Yun, a family of weaponsmiths five centuries ago that turned to the performing arts. Canon calls her a young actress and 'a young girl' but gives no age.

facts.title: Vago Mundo
facts.species: God (Archon); an elemental being of great age
facts.occupation: Consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor; retired Geo Archon
facts.vision: none (an imitation Geo Vision; his Gnosis went to the Tsaritsa)
facts.identity_notes: Morax is his divine name, Rex Lapis his title as Liyue's ruler, and 'Zhongli' the name he uses 'when on leave'. The public believes Rex Lapis died at the Rite of Descension.

facts.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
facts.species: Angel (divine envoy made under the heavens' plan); restored from her Three Deadly Selves
facts.occupation: Wandering adeptus; occasional teacher of history and the classics at Liyue schools
facts.identity_notes: Zibai is the restored original. The Liyue 'White Horse Adeptus' of the Archon War and the Eight Adepts was her Third Deadly Self, Ziqiao (some wiki pages spell it Zijiao); her First Self was Ziju and her Second Zizhi. Their eye colours (blue Ziju, red Zizhi, gold Ziqiao and her default) still surface in her.

facts.title: Helios-Forger
facts.occupation: Sage; builder of the Dainichi Mikoshi
facts.era: about 6,000 years ago, shortly before and after the War of Funerary Flame (the wiki's date, not stated in a single in-game line)
facts.identity_notes: 'Aberaku' is the Inazuman-style rendering of his name used in Enkanomiya; the older chronicle text and Istoria call him Abrax. He is known today only as a spectral Shade of Tokoyo, not as a living person.

historical.ahpub.name: Ahpub
aliases: Chief of the Collective of Plenty

facts.title: Chief of the Collective of Plenty
facts.occupation: Warrior; Chief of the Collective of Plenty
facts.era: Age of dragons and the Grand Alliance, roughly two thousand years before the present (the Alliance period under Xbalanque and Och-Kan)
facts.identity_notes: 'Ahpub' is his only given name. Uwezo ('strength' or 'power') is his Ancient Name, later passed on within the Collective of Plenty to Iansan.

facts.title: Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions
facts.occupation: First Moonchanter; former handmaiden of the Archpriestess
facts.era: About 500 years before the present (Cataclysm era)
facts.identity_notes: Her fate and date of death are not stated; she is known only through records, item text and a kuuvahki recording at the Sanctum of the Oathbearer.

facts.title: Valiant One
facts.occupation: First of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords; Speaker of the Sovereign Rulers' Council
facts.era: Natlantea, the age of the dragon civilization, about 2,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Called CL-01 in council records and 'Dragonlord' by the wiki. The wiki lists 'Chuq'ab' as Mayan for power and gives 'Valiant One' as the in-game title.

facts.occupation: Swordsmith of the Akame School (Isshin Art, Raiden Gokaden)
facts.era: Around 100 years before the present (Case of the Eccentric)
facts.identity_notes: He changed his name after leaving Inazuma; the name he used in Snezhnaya is not given.

facts.title: Deathless Oni of Seirai
facts.species: Unclear; styled an oni, listed with the oni group on the wiki
facts.occupation: Pirate captain and bandit; rebel against the Shogunate
facts.era: About 500 years before the present, after the cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: Zaemon is the part of his full name used in the sources. He is called Deathless Oni of Seirai by himself in the item text of The Catch; the nature of that title is not explained.

facts.title: Touzannou (Viceroy of the East)
facts.occupation: General of the Watatsumi invasion force; vassal ruler of Yashiori Island
facts.era: About 2,000 years before the present (Narukami-Watatsumi War)
facts.identity_notes: He had no name or surname; Touzannou was a title from Orobashi, and Akuou ('Wicked King') is the name used by Yashiori's people and now more widely.

facts.title: Lord-Artificer
facts.occupation: Inventor and engineer; researcher at the Institute of Natural Philosophy; Marechaussee Hunter; founding director of the Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering
facts.era: Around the cataclysm and the decades after it, roughly four to five centuries before the present
facts.identity_notes: Also styled Duke (Scarlet Proof artifact text) and White Cavalier of Protection (Riddles Awaiting Answers, 4.1; also on his tombstone). Not to be confused with his sister Mary-Ann Guillotin or his adoptive father Emanuel Guillotin.

facts.occupation: Leader of the Treasure Hoarders as the second Reed Miller
facts.era: About five hundred years before the present (the Cataclysm)
facts.identity_notes: 'Alia' is the name in Aila's and Solovei's writings and in the Nightingale's Song quests. Tolfin (The Raven's Legacy) says he does not know the second Reed Miller's real name and calls her a traitor to the Frostmoon Scions; the wiki treats the two as one person. Wagtail in the pulp novels is a fictional character, not her.

facts.title: Grand Duke of the Domovoy
facts.occupation: Grand Duke of the Domovoy; lord of Kitezhgrad, then Novokitezhgrad; controlled the city's mining
facts.era: From before the unification of Snezhnaya (about 3,000 years ago) to shortly before the Traveler's visit

facts.title: Leader of the Outriders
facts.occupation: Former mercenary leader; founder and leader of the Outriders; Knights of Favonius member
facts.era: Modern day; active in the Knights decades before the story and until about four years before Prologue
facts.identity_notes: No personal name is given in canon. Not a historical figure in the strict sense; filed here as a figure known only through other people's accounts.

facts.occupation: Huntress and archer; Decarabian's favoured counsellor and executor
facts.era: Archon War (Age of Kings), about 2,600 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: The weapon Amos' Bow is named for her. Her appearance (long white hair) is known only from the story teaser The Boy and the Whirlwind.

facts.title: Exalted Saint
facts.pronouns: she/her in her original form; he/him in item texts while she inhabits the youth's body
facts.species: Voyager from the sea of stars (a Chronicler of an interstellar civilization)
facts.occupation: Chronicler; later Exalted Saint and co-ruler of Hyperborea
facts.era: End of the unified civilization, around the war of funerary flame (about 6,000 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Known from artifact and weapon texts, a Liyuean folk tale, a hymn, a time-capsule letter and the Belyi Tsar's notes; no in-game speaking role. The wiki identifies a figure beside Koitar in Nicole's official character teaser as Anacharsis. The host body was an unnamed Hyperborean youth with star-shaped pupils, left behind when she departed.

facts.title: Mage "M"; Story-Witch
facts.occupation: Author; Hexenzirkel member
facts.era: Died roughly 500-400 years ago (wiki estimate); lived into old age after the Cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: Her code name M predates the revelation that her middle name is Marie; Alice had already taken A. Simulanka's people called her a Goddess of Fate.

facts.title: Marshal Regent
facts.occupation: Knight Marshal of the Schwanenritter; temporary Regent of Khaenri'ah
facts.era: Khaenri'ah, the cataclysm (about 500 years before the main story)
facts.identity_notes: Appears only through ancient documents and ruins in Sumeru; he is never seen or heard. His ultimate fate is not stated.

facts.occupation: Armory Palace researcher of kuuvahki and moon fragments
facts.era: Shortly before the Traveler's visit to Lempo Isle (Nod-Krai, 6.x); exact date not given
facts.identity_notes: Known only through in-world notes; he is never met. Not to be confused with Preobrazhensky.

facts.occupation: Legendary Aranara warrior; Ararakalari master
facts.era: Around the cataclysm, several hundred years before the game
facts.identity_notes: Known only through Aranara storytelling and the stone locks he left; he never appears on screen. The Aranara measure time in tree cycles, so the exact date is not given.

facts.occupation: First Aranara; hero of the cataclysm; seal-keeper
facts.era: From the creation of the Dharma Forest, through the cataclysm (several hundred years before the game)
facts.identity_notes: Aranara speak of the end of life as returning to Sarva (the Irminsul's dream-realm); in the game's terms he has died. His withered Vasara Tree was the setting of the fight with Marana's Avatar. He is unnamed ('???') when first met in Festival Utsava.

facts.title: Goddess of the Eternal Moon
facts.occupation: Moon Goddess; sovereign of the night sky in rotation with her sisters
facts.era: The Old World, through the war of funerary flame; roughly 6,000 years before the present according to Nod-Krai content
facts.identity_notes: Not one of The Seven. The Eternal Moon is the first and largest of the Three Moons.

facts.title: Lion of Light
facts.occupation: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius (formerly); Lionfang Knight
facts.era: Mondstadt, around the cataclysm 500 years before the main story
facts.identity_notes: Fought with a greatsword and longsword together. Born into a long line of knights. The 'Lion' title descends from Vennessa's Lionfang (Dandelion) Knight title. He bore no Vision.

facts.title: Shrine Maiden
facts.occupation: Shrine maiden of Asase Shrine; trained at the Grand Narukami Shrine
facts.era: About 500 years before the present (the cataclysm and the Seirai rebellion)
facts.identity_notes: Early localization rendered the kanji of her given name as 'Kanade'; English switched to Hibiki in 2.1.

facts.occupation: Hero of the rebellion against Och-Kan
facts.era: About 2,000 years ago, in the age of Och-Kan and the second Pyro Archon
facts.identity_notes: Known only from the Unfinished Reverie artifact set. His name echoes the historical Inca ruler Atahualpa, as the wiki notes.

facts.title: Harmost
facts.occupation: Harmost (governor, military commander and musician) of Remuria
facts.era: The age of the kingdom of Remuria, many centuries before the present; canon gives no dates
facts.identity_notes: Not the same person as Aurelius, the NPC of Vimara Village, and not the hero of the stage trilogy 'The Saga of Aurelius', who is believed fictional.

facts.title: Founder of the Treasure Hoarders; Master Thief; King/Ruler of Elysium
facts.occupation: Former Snezhnayan non-commissioned officer; outlaw leader and master thief
facts.era: About 500 years before the present (just before the Cataclysm)
facts.identity_notes: Relya is a familiar form of Avrelian. 'Reed Miller' was an alias used by at least three people; Avrelian was the first. Executed in Snezhnograd.

facts.title: Umigozen
facts.occupation: Pearl diver and warrior; commander of the first Watatsumi navy
facts.era: Archon War, the Narukami-Watatsumi War, about 2,000 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Umigozen is her honorific; the Yuna Clan is the family of her twin Mouun.

facts.title: Admiral of the Fontaine Navy; Vice Director of the Narzissenkreuz Institute
facts.occupation: Admiral of the Fontaine Navy (Armada), later Vice Director of the Narzissenkreuz Institute
facts.era: The cataclysm, roughly five hundred years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Per the wiki, the wielder of the weapon Tidal Shadow; not the narrator of the Lovecraft story the name echoes.

facts.title: Belyi Tsar
facts.species: Incomplete Primordial Human born from the Cryo Dragon's remains (long believed to be a fae); god
facts.occupation: Emperor of the Pale Star Court; first Cryo Archon of Snezhnaya
facts.era: Pale Star Court to the cataclysm (ended 500 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Belyi Tsar ('White Tsar') is the title he took after defeating Miscislav; his personal name was Monomakh Snezhnyi. He is the 'Snow-King', 'Winter Tsar' and 'White Emperor' of item lore and 'Pakkaisukko' of Frostmoon Scion hymns. He used a fae form among fae; his own body was something else.

facts.occupation: Spear-wielding sorceress who hunted aristocrats and 'the vile'; teacher of Eberhart
facts.era: Late Aristocratic period, about 1,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Her name is not revealed in-game; 'Josephine' is a wiki inference from The First Great Magic.

facts.title: Bleeding Idol
facts.occupation: Musician; Harmost of Remuria; leader of the Golden Troupe
facts.era: Remuria, thousands of years before the present; resurfaces in Version 4.6
facts.identity_notes: He was born on a conquered isle (name not given) and lived his adult life in Remuria. 'Boethius' in the Canticles of Harmony quests is the fragmentary, corrupted spirit that Phobos wears. The man himself acted for decades under Phobos's influence before the fall.

facts.title: General Chizapus
facts.occupation: Yaksha, demon-slaying guardian of Rex Lapis
facts.era: Archon War and its aftermath (several millennia before the present)
facts.identity_notes: Her Chinese name is Fanan; General Chizapus is her yaksha title. Her pronouns and Hydro element come from wiki summaries of the yaksha trailers and cast confirmations.

facts.title: Marshal Vritras
facts.occupation: Leader of the Five Foremost Yakshas; demon-slaying guardian of Rex Lapis
facts.era: Archon War aftermath and the cataclysm (about five hundred years ago)
facts.identity_notes: He lost his own name to madness, so the battle of The Chasm was remembered with a 'Nameless Yaksha'. His Chinese name is Fushe. Electro and the title Marshal Vritras are stated by Xiao in the Interlude Chapter; the four arms and tattoos come from the wiki's reading of the story trailers and his artifact lore.

facts.occupation: Thaumaturge; fought with the Millelith
facts.era: About 500 years before the present (Cataclysm era)
facts.identity_notes: Known only through the Note of Unknown Origin and echoes in the Chasm's sealed space; no portrait, voice-over or direct dialogue of his own is established beyond a recorded seal incantation shared with Bosacius.

facts.title: Grand Duke; last Governor of Nod-Krai
facts.occupation: Governor of Nod-Krai; later the third Reed Miller and author of the Great Treasure legend
facts.era: Around the Cataclysm, about five hundred years before the present, and the decades after it
facts.identity_notes: 'Brahe the Bard' and 'Grand Duke Trubetskoy' are pen names he used for his fabricated Reed Miller stories. The third Reed Miller is one person; Reed Miller is a title worn by Avrelian, Alia and Brahe in that order.

facts.title: Turnfire
facts.occupation: Courier and warrior of the Scions of the Canopy; one of the six heroes of the war against the Abyss
facts.era: The cataclysm, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Malipo ('Turnfire') is the Ancient Name of the Scions of the Canopy. Burkina is shown as an early bearer; the Heroes of Natlan table lists Yupanqui before him (an assumption). It is now carried by Kinich. He is shown with the polearm Footprint of the Rainbow in flashbacks, and Fruitful Hook is his weapon in item lore.

facts.title: Burner of Cities
facts.occupation: Leader of a rebellion of fae raiders
facts.era: Shortly after the Tsaritsa took control of Snezhnaya, about 500 years ago
facts.identity_notes: 'Burner of Cities' is an epithet she adopted; her original name is not given.

facts.occupation: Founder and first president of the Spina di Rosula
facts.era: Fontaine, roughly three years before the Fontaine Archon Quest
facts.identity_notes: Known in Poisson as 'Callas the Unfaithful' from his arrest until Navia cleared his name. The aquabus Callas Line is named after him.

facts.title: Goddess of the Frost Moon
facts.species: Moon goddess; a being made by the Dragon King Nibelung
facts.occupation: Goddess of the Frost Moon, one of three Moon Sisters
facts.era: The Old World, before and during the war of funerary flame (thousands of years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Known as Canon to the sisters and in the True Moon quest, Huurrekuutar to the Frostmoon Scions, and Prusmene in a hymn from Arcadia. The wiki treats these as one goddess.

facts.occupation: Research assistant at the Institute of Natural Philosophy
facts.era: Around the cataclysm, roughly five hundred years before the present
facts.identity_notes: A fragment or shadow of him persists in the Book of Revealing; his remains are tied to the origins of Narzissenkreuz and Caterpillar (see uncertainties).

facts.title: Golden Hunter
facts.species: Remurian (stone body with Ichor); his soul has inhabited several golem and animal bodies
facts.occupation: Harmost of Remuria; founder of the Marechaussee Hunters; spirit-keeper of the old realm
facts.era: Remuria, thousands of years before the present; guards the old realm until Version 4.6
facts.identity_notes: 'Cassiodor' is a moniker. A 4.0 artifact text says the conquered servant's birth name is remembered by no one. In 4.6 he is first met as 'Ouranides of Ouranopolis' inside a white cat, which Paimon names Osse and then Monsieur Os.

historical.chaac.name: Chaac
aliases: first receiver of the primal fire

facts.occupation: Legendary first tribal hero of Natlan
facts.era: Legendary: in the age before the first Pyro Archon, when dragons ruled and the Lord of the Night held the night realm
facts.identity_notes: Known only through legends in item texts. The wiki notes the name is that of the Maya rain and thunder god.

facts.era: Thousands of years ago (Archon War era)
facts.identity_notes: 'Chi' is also a generic term for dragon-like sea monsters of Liyue; this entry concerns the god of Qingce unless stated. It is known only through documents, legend and Morax's seals; it never speaks.

facts.occupation: Mediator of the Spina di Rosula
facts.era: Fontaine, before Navia's birth and the Fontaine story
facts.identity_notes: The Caspar surname is the wiki infobox reading (House of Caspar, as with Callas); the quests cited here only use 'Clementine'. She is never shown alive and has no voiced appearance.

facts.species: Human; the later 'Clervie' is a sentient shadow
facts.occupation: Orphan of the House of the Hearth (as its head's daughter)
facts.age: Died at sixteen; her shadow appears as a six-year-old child
facts.era: Over a decade before Version 4.0; her shadow appears in Version 4.6
facts.identity_notes: The Clervie met in 'When the Hearth-Flame Goes Out' is a shadow left behind by Arlecchino's flames, not the living girl. She remembers only her first years and does not know she died. Both versions are called Clervie in the quests.

historical.cochanina.name: Cochanina
aliases: Surfing champion of the People of the Springs

facts.title: Pyro Archon
facts.species: human (an Archon, a mortal who ascended)
facts.occupation: Pyro Archon; surfing champion of the People of the Springs
facts.era: After Xbalanque's founding of the Pyro Archon system and before the present; she belongs to the generation(s) that contained the Bakunawa in the Mare Jivari
facts.identity_notes: Natlanese Archons are mortals who ascend and not eternal gods. Cochanina is not the first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque. Whether she also bore the divine name Haborym is inferred by the wiki and not stated for her.

facts.occupation: Playwright
facts.era: Fontaine, about 500 years ago, around the time of the cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: Presumed to have died when the opera house was destroyed on the day of his last premiere. The posthumous play 'Clockwork Coppelia' also features a character named after him.

facts.title: The Knave
facts.occupation: Fatui Harbinger (the Knave); head of the House of the Hearth
facts.element: Hydro (seen in the animated short; Cryo possible)
facts.era: Before Version 4.0; the wiki dates her death to over a decade before the story
facts.identity_notes: Her Harbinger codename is never stated. Arlecchino's Character Story 3 says Peruere took both the Knave title and the name Arlecchino on promotion, and Character Story 5 says she inherited the name, so the previous Knave probably used it too; this is an inference.

facts.occupation: Dragon-lord of the old world
facts.era: Before the Heavenly Principles' victory; the corpse's effects continue to 7.1
facts.identity_notes: Canon gives no personal name, gender or voice. The wiki treats 'its authority' as Cryo.

facts.title: Dawnlight Swordswoman
facts.occupation: Sword-dancer and fighter of the Wanderer's Troupe; later gladiator
facts.era: Late Aristocratic period, about 1,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Her personal name is not given. 'Dawnlight' was a title earned in the arena.

facts.title: God of Storms
facts.occupation: God and ruler of Old Mondstadt
facts.era: Archon War (Age of Kings), about 2,600 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Not one of The Seven. English item text calls him an Anemo Archon (the Chinese text says wind god); Barbatos, who ascended after his fall, is the first and only Anemo Archon of The Seven.

historical.dwight-lasker.name: Dwight Lasker
aliases: Director of the Institute of Natural Philosophy

facts.title: Director of the Institute of Natural Philosophy
facts.occupation: Director of the Institute of Natural Philosophy
facts.era: Fontaine, the cataclysm era roughly 500 years ago and the decades after
facts.identity_notes: His name appears in the Marechaussee Hunter artifact texts as 'Dwight' and 'Lasker'. The Ancient Notes are labelled as written by the Institute's director, which the wiki identifies as Dwight.

facts.occupation: illegitimate aristocratic heir; spear wielder
facts.era: Aristocratic period
facts.identity_notes: The family is only probably Landrich's; canon never gives him a family name.

facts.occupation: Outlaw leader and tavern keeper in Fleuve Cendre
facts.era: Fontaine, before the cataclysm (over 500 years before the present)
facts.identity_notes: Known only through item texts and notes. He wielded a bronze pipe he called the Ferryman. His son Jakob later became Jakob Ingold.

facts.title: Mistress of Many Waters
facts.species: God; created as the heart of the Primordial Sea
facts.occupation: Hydro Archon and ruler of Fontaine (about 2,000 to 500 years ago)
facts.era: Created after the Hydro Dragon's removal; imprisoned in the Primordial Sea through Remuria's age; Hydro Archon from about 2,000 years ago until the cataclysm 500 years ago.
facts.identity_notes: Called God of Justice by implication: Focalors calls 'existence' Egeria's justice. Her body became the Amrita in Sumeru; her consciousness persists in the Harvisptokhm, which the Pari worship.

facts.species: Colossal beast of unknown kind; not native to Teyvat's world according to the wiki
facts.era: Lived and fell during the cataclysm about 500 years ago; a conscious remnant lingers in his corpse.
facts.identity_notes: Appears only as a spirit in Melusine form during a brief 'time of life'. His true form is a gigantic beast whose remains make up much of the Beryl Region. The location of the same name (the surface remains) is a separate subarea of the Beryl Region.

facts.title: Marechaussee Hunter
facts.occupation: Former Marechaussee Phantom hunter and commander; guardian of two Institute children
facts.era: About 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Known mainly through the Marechaussee Hunter artifact set, the weapon Rightful Reward and Institute documents; he has no voice-overs and never appears in person.

facts.title: High King of Aremorica
facts.occupation: Singer; High King of Aremorica; leader of the Lochknights
facts.era: Final years of the Remurian Empire
facts.identity_notes: Her sword is named Hauteclaire in La Chanson d'Erinnyes, per the wiki. The scepter Splendor of Tranquil Waters is credited to her in its weapon text.

facts.title: Harmost; the benefactrix
facts.occupation: Harmost of Remuria
facts.era: Remuria, thousands of years before the present; died when Remuria fell
facts.identity_notes: A Harmost of Remuria, born in the capital. Known only from environmental texts, a weapon description and notes; she never appears in person.

facts.title: Grand Duke
facts.occupation: Grand Duke of the Belyi Tsar's court; first Commander of the Druzhna
facts.era: Archon War and the cataclysm (about 500 years ago and earlier)
facts.identity_notes: Lost one eye to his wife's arrow, according to the General History of Snezhnaya.

facts.title: Professor
facts.occupation: Fatui professor; commander of the Desert Expedition Team
facts.era: During the Desert of Hadramaveth content (Version 3.4)
facts.identity_notes: Known only through notes and subordinates' remarks; he is never met.

facts.title: Senior Researcher
facts.occupation: Senior Researcher in the Post-Apocalyptic Elysium bunker
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Appears only in recordings and written logs in the bunker; the recordings credit her as a 'Gentle Female Voice'.

facts.title: Dendro Archon (former); God of Wisdom
facts.occupation: Former ruler of Sumeru; guardian of Irminsul
facts.era: Died in the cataclysm, about 500 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Removed from Irminsul in 3.2 at her own request, so all of Teyvat except the Traveler forgot her and history now names Nahida as the only Dendro Archon. 'Queen Aranyani' was the Aranara's name for her. Her remnant's voice is summarised in the sub-entry on her remaining consciousness.

facts.species: Human (a legend claims he became an adeptus)
facts.occupation: Martial nomad; swordsman and spearman
facts.era: Distant past; exact time not stated
facts.identity_notes: Known through the Guhua Clan's traditions, his sword manuals and inscriptions and weapon text. The weapon Prototype Archaic is named simply 'Guhua' in its description, but whether the person made or owned it is not shown in the sources read.

facts.title: God of Dust
facts.species: God (one of the ancient gods of the Archon War era)
facts.occupation: Co-ruler of the Guili Assembly; inventor
facts.era: Archon War (died with the fall of the Guili Assembly, about 3,700 years before the present)
facts.identity_notes: Guizhong is the name her friends used; Haagentus is her divine name, first given by Cloud Retainer in the 3.4 Lantern Rite event. English texts also call her Lord of Dust. No element is ever stated for her.

historical.gunnhildr.name: Gunnhildr
aliases: first priestess of the Gunnhildr Clan

facts.occupation: clan leader and first priestess
facts.era: Decarabian's era (the Biography places it three thousand years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Distinct from Frederica Gunnhildr, the later Knights of Favonius Grand Master. The clan took her name after her death.

facts.occupation: military doctor; second-in-command to Capitano
facts.era: Khaenri'ah, the cataclysm (about 500 years before the main story)
facts.identity_notes: Never appears alive. Every on-screen appearance is a soul manifesting through Ororon (5.1), a flashback voice (5.2) or a 'story' in the Night Kingdom (5.3).

facts.title: Sentinel of the Golden Hall
facts.occupation: Knight Commander of the Schwanenritter (earlier a Garrison Commander)
facts.era: Khaenri'ah and Sumeru, during the cataclysm (about 500 years before the main story)
facts.identity_notes: Known only from documents and ruins in Sumeru; never seen or heard. Canon does not state Hadura's gender.

facts.title: Great Kitsune; Great Matriarch
facts.occupation: Matriarch of the Hakushin Clan; manager of a shrine on Mt. Yougou
facts.era: Far in the past; canon gives no date
facts.identity_notes: The wiki says the Grand Narukami Shrine is implied to have already existed in her lifetime.

facts.occupation: Master weaponsmith
facts.era: around the time of the cataclysm, five hundred years ago
facts.identity_notes: Known only through weapon descriptions (Prototype and Blackcliff series). Chinese name 寒武. His son Han Ce is a separate figure and is not written as a separate entry here.

facts.title: God of Salt
facts.occupation: God of Salt; protector of refugees from the Archon War
facts.era: Before and during the Archon War (several millennia ago)
facts.identity_notes: Her killer is described as the first and last king of Sal Terrae in an adventurer's diary; in the Sal Flore quest Zhongli says only that some among her people did it. Her elemental affinity is not stated in canon and is left blank.

facts.title: Greatest of Sages
facts.species: Tighnarian; a human sage raised to a god's familiar
facts.occupation: Sage, priest and warrior; one of King Deshret's Seven Pillars; founder of the Temple of Silence
facts.era: Aftermath of King Deshret's civilization, more than a thousand years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Not the same as Cyno. Cyno carries two Ba Fragments of Hermanubis's power; the sage himself is gone.

historical.hiiragi-hiroshi.name: Hiiragi Hiroshi
aliases: the Kanjou Head who built Ritou

facts.title: Kanjou Commissioner
facts.occupation: Head of the Hiiragi Clan; Kanjou Commissioner
facts.era: about 500 years ago, after the cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: Not to be confused with the modern NPC Hiroshi, a separate wiki page. The Ornate Kabuto text calls him young at the time of his sword training.

historical.holy-sovereign.name: Maghan's Master
aliases: The last Holy Sovereign of Mictlan

facts.title: Holy Sovereign
facts.occupation: Holy Sovereign of the valley tribe (forerunner of Mictlan); later its Wayob
facts.era: About 2,000 years ago, near the end of Xiuhcoatl's reign
facts.identity_notes: The wiki page is titled "Maghan's Master" because canon gives her no personal name; this archive's id slug is a descriptive choice.

facts.occupation: Shaman and scroll-weaver
facts.era: About 200 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Appears only as a voice and in flashback and woven-scroll depictions; she is never met in the present.

facts.title: Hydro Dragon Sovereign
facts.occupation: Ruler of the Hydro Vishaps; one of the Seven Sovereigns
facts.era: The old world before the Heavenly Principles' victory
facts.identity_notes: The original Hydro Dragon is dead. The current Hydro Sovereign is Neuvillette, whose own entry covers his life.

facts.title: Tricksy-Witch
facts.occupation: Politician; first Mayor of Snezhnograd and Speaker of the Snezhnograd Veche (the city is inferred, see uncertainties); member of the Hexenzirkel (codename J)
facts.era: Early years of the Tsaritsa's reign, after the Cataclysm of about 500 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Surname is given only as the initial N. Her Hexenzirkel codename is the single letter J; her epithet is Tricksy-Witch (in-game English title). The wiki dates her death to between 500 and 400 years ago; no primary text giving that range was found.

facts.occupation: warrior
facts.era: Fall of Sal Vindagnyr, before the founding of Barbatos's Mondstadt
facts.identity_notes: He is not native to Sal Vindagnyr. The wiki treats his origin as unknown.

facts.title: General Musatas
facts.occupation: Yaksha warrior in the service of Rex Lapis
facts.era: Archon War and the centuries after it
facts.identity_notes: Xiao gives the title 'General Musatas' in the 2.7 quest At Tunnel's End, Light. Her element and the nickname 'Flame Yaksha' come from a voice actor's public statement as relayed by the wiki, not from in-game text.

facts.occupation: Aristocrat; member of the Dragonspine expedition
facts.era: Late Aristocratic period, about 1,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Known only from the Ancient Investigation Journals and the Alley Flash text. Pyro is the wiki infobox's element for his Vision; the journal itself only says he counterattacked with his Vision.

facts.title: Vinster King
facts.occupation: King of Khaenri'ah, the last Vinster King of the Eclipse Dynasty
facts.era: Eclipse Dynasty, ending with the cataclysm about five hundred years ago
facts.identity_notes: Usually called Irmin or the Vinster King; Rerir addresses him as 'Irminsul' (All Is Foretold, 6.1), which the wiki treats as his real name. The name is shared with the great tree Irminsul, but canon draws no link between the two. He never appears on screen and has no recorded voice.

facts.title: Douin
facts.occupation: Swordsman; founder of the Iwakura Art; Kujou Clan sword instructor
facts.era: five hundred years ago (the cataclysm and after)
facts.identity_notes: Wiki infobox calls him 'deceased: past'; no text describes his death. Older text called him 'Iwakura Doukei' and 'Michihira'; in 3.3 these were revised to Michihiro. 'Douin' is his title as the Kujou instructor, and the later 'In' suffix is given to masters of the Iwakura Art.

historical.ix-ajkotzij-iqismal-waxak.name: Ix Ajkotz'i'j Iq'ismal Waxak
aliases: Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers

facts.title: Priestess of Floral Candles and Skyborne Feathers
facts.occupation: Eighth Sovereign Lord; ruler of Ch'upikaq Tajin
facts.era: Age of the ancient dragons, during and after the war of funerary flame
facts.identity_notes: Known only through records, weapon text and the Smoldering quest; she never speaks in the present. Her Sovereign Lord designation is CL-08.

historical.ix-jelal-kual-ka.name: Ix Je'lal K'ua'l Ka'
aliases: Second of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords

facts.title: Jade Maiden
facts.species: Dragon (Dragonlord); an artificial ruler created by Xiuhcoatl per the wiki
facts.occupation: Second of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords; dragon artisan
facts.era: Dragon-ruled Natlan, before and during the Ochkanatlan era
facts.identity_notes: Jade Maiden is her title. The Chain Breaker description calls her a dragon artisan without naming her; the wiki links the two.

historical.ix-kemonel-jasjatem-oox.name: Ix Kemonel Jasjatem Oox
aliases: Third of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords

facts.title: Weaver of Secrets
facts.species: Dragon (Dragonlord); an artificial ruler created by Xiuhcoatl per the wiki
facts.occupation: Third of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords; ruler of an unnamed territory in the Tezcatepetonco Range
facts.era: Dragon-ruled Natlan; the covenant with Wagadu belongs to the reign of Och-Kan
facts.identity_notes: The wiki says she merged her consciousness into the Night Kingdom.

facts.title: Chronicler of the End Times
facts.species: Dragon (Dragonlord); styled in her own title as a Type-L Self-Regulating Overseer Array Integrated Processing Unit
