facts.occupation: Ninth of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords; ruler of Chichen Uctokah
facts.era: Dragon-ruled Natlan through the Ochkanatlan era; her soul was released in the present day (5.2)
facts.identity_notes: Ixlel is the nickname Paimon gives her in the quest and the name used by the wiki. The wiki reads the title Chronicler of the End Times as a Council record designation.

historical.ixquieh.name: Ixquieh
aliases: Chief of the Children of Echoes

facts.title: Hero of the Forged Flame
facts.occupation: Forgemaster and engineer; first Chief of the Children of Echoes
facts.era: Time of the Grand Alliance in Natlan, roughly two thousand years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Sundjatta's Phlogiston Forge Notes say she had no parents to give her a name, so she named herself in the draconic style. She is the first recorded bearer of the Ancient Name Baraka. Her appearance is not described in canon text found.

historical.izmaylov.name: Izmaylov
aliases: President of the Royal Energy Commission

facts.title: President of the Royal Energy Commission of Snezhnaya
facts.occupation: President of the Royal Energy Commission; head of the Izmaylov family and founder of the High Table
facts.era: Born in Kitezhgrad in the reign of the Belyi Tsar; president under the Tsaritsa; died a few months before the Traveler's visit
facts.identity_notes: 'Pakhan' is part of his name as given; the Izmaylov gang calls him the Old Sire and his son the Young Sire.

facts.title: Mondstadt Ecologist
facts.occupation: Ecologist and researcher; author
facts.era: Unknown; the wiki says he lived an unknown time ago, and the ballad book speaks of his late years
facts.identity_notes: Known only through book credits and his descendants. He is not the same person as Ella Musk, who is a living scholar.

facts.occupation: Swordsmith of the Isshin Art; later traveller and rock-garden maker
facts.era: the generation between the Case of the Eccentric and Kazuha's childhood
facts.identity_notes: Voiced only in Kazuha's memory domains in the limited Summertime Odyssey event (2.8); the 2.6 event Hues of the Violet Garden describes his quarrel with Yoshinori. The wiki gives Niwa Clan ancestry for the line.

facts.occupation: Head of the Kaedehara household; bonsai keeper
facts.era: the generation before Kazuha, before the Vision Hunt Decree
facts.identity_notes: Appears only as a voice in Kazuha's memory domains in the limited Summertime Odyssey event (2.8) and as the addressee of Kazuha's letter. The wiki's own profile section is empty.

facts.occupation: Swordsmith; head of the Kaedehara Clan and leader of the Isshin Art; later bonsai hobbyist
facts.era: about 100 years before the present (the Case of the Eccentric)
facts.identity_notes: Born into the Niwa Clan and adopted into the Kaedehara Clan after his father disappeared. He is not an obtainable or playable character; he speaks only in a 2.6 flashback. The Kamisato affiliation above is only the shared pursuit; he was Kaedehara, not Kamisato.

facts.occupation: Member of the Kamisato Clan, mother of its present leaders
facts.era: Recent past; died while Ayaka was young
facts.identity_notes: Known only through Ayaka's and Ayato's voice-overs and Ayaka's Story Quest. Her husband is mentioned as deceased and is never named.

facts.title: Onmyouji
facts.occupation: Onmyouji of the Kamuna Clan; later shikigami-maker
facts.era: About 500 years ago (Cataclysm era) and some decades after
facts.identity_notes: Last known to have left for unknown places after Shiki Taishou persuaded him to let go of his burdens. Appears only in recollected scenes and flashbacks.

facts.title: Great Thunderbird
facts.era: Ancient history, long before the Traveler's arrival
facts.identity_notes: 'Kanna Kapatcir' is the name Ruu gave her ('Great Eagle of the Storm' in English subtitles); she had forgotten both name and namer. Most lore calls her an eagle, but Narukami's Affection and the Chinese text of Octave of the Maushiro describe an owl-like bird.

facts.occupation: Journalist, later a companion of explorers
facts.era: Fontaine, around the cataclysm (roughly 400-500 years before the present)
facts.identity_notes: Named after a real-world aviation pioneer. Rene's notes imply his body differs from the Fontainian composition of Jakob and Rene, which the wiki reads as meaning he was not descended from native Fontainians.

facts.title: Yoriki
facts.occupation: Yoriki (retainer-officer) of the Inazuma Shogunate under Inspector Mikoshi Nagamasa
facts.era: Around 400 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Written 桂木 in Japanese. No family name or full name is stated.

facts.occupation: Rtawahist Darshan scholar; formerly of the Akademiya
facts.era: Died about twenty years before Chapter III (the game's present)
facts.identity_notes: His name is never given. He has no on-screen appearance; he is known from Kaveh's Character Story 2, the 3.7 Hangout Event 'Wondrous Times' (Faranak's drawing) and the 3.6 limited event A Parade of Providence.

facts.era: During the Vision Hunt Decree, in the years before the Traveler reached Inazuma
facts.identity_notes: His name is never given in game. The community nickname 'Tomo' (Japanese for 'friend') is fan usage, not canon.

historical.king-deshret.name: King Deshret
aliases: King of the Great Red Sand

facts.title: Lord of Deserts
facts.occupation: God-king of the desert civilization
facts.era: Archon War, thousands of years ago
facts.identity_notes: King Deshret is his title; Al-Ahmar is his personal name and Amun his divine name (Apep, 3.6). Chinese 'Chiwang' means 'Red King', hence 'Scarlet King' in some English text.

facts.title: Kitain the Serpent
facts.occupation: Spearman; Yashiori Guardian and Tatarigami hunter
facts.era: Before the cataclysm; exact dates not stated
facts.identity_notes: Known only from the Kitain Cross Spear's description, a children's song and wiki summaries. Almost nothing personal is recorded.

facts.title: The Last Prefect of Yashiori
facts.occupation: Prefect of Yashiori; spearman
facts.era: The cataclysm (about 500 years before the present) and the decades after it
facts.identity_notes: Inazuma's public memory (Kokomi, the world quest 'Orobashi's Legacy') honours a Kitain who died or vanished in battle. His own letter says otherwise.

facts.title: Hakushin Kitsune; Lady Saiguu
facts.occupation: Kitsune goddess and head of the Grand Narukami Shrine; later guardian at the Shogun's side
facts.era: Around 500 years ago; lost in the cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: 'Saiguu' is a title ('Fox High Priestess' in Japanese); her personal name is never given.

historical.knight-of-the-golden-bough.name: Knight of the Golden Bough
aliases: Gunnhildr, the Knight of the Golden Bough

facts.title: Knight of the Golden Bough
facts.occupation: Knight; leader of Arcadian refugees
facts.era: Around the fall of Arcadia, before Decarabian's rule over Old Mondstadt ended (the wiki's clan-origin account)
facts.identity_notes: Not to be confused with the Gunnhildr of the clan Biography, nor with Frederica Gunnhildr, the later Grand Master. The knight's gender is not stated in the sources read here (the German name text is feminine).

facts.occupation: Troupe fighter; later leader of a secret society
facts.era: About a thousand years ago, in the late years of the Mondstadt Aristocracy (the wiki's dating of the Wanderer's Troupe)
facts.identity_notes: Kreuzlied is an alias ascribed to him; his true name is not given. The weapon text calls him a traitor and outcast of the Lawrence Clan.

facts.occupation: General; builder of the Kujou Encampment
facts.era: The cataclysm, hundreds of years ago
facts.identity_notes: The viewpoint spells the name 'Shigeyori Kujou'; the archive uses the Japanese order.

facts.title: Sage of the Stolen Flame
facts.species: Dragon (Dragonborn prince of Natlantea); able to wear human disguises
facts.occupation: Regent of Natlantea; teacher of Phlogiston to humans
facts.era: Age of the Seven Sovereigns through the era of the tribes and Ochkanatlan, to about the present of the 5.x story
facts.identity_notes: Kukulkan is, in his words, the first of his names. In human legend the Sage is a man called Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, one of the many names Kukulkan says he created. Several named people are masks or disguises he wore, among them Bona, Manqu, and (strongly implied) Titu and Legba. The element field is inferred from his origin in the primal flame; canon gives him no Vision.

facts.occupation: Aristocrat; head of his family, which clan is not stated
facts.era: Aristocratic period, about 1,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Never appears in person; known only as 'Master Landrich' in the Ancient Investigation Journals. A Hydro Abyss Mage called Landrich appears in Diluc's Story Quest; the wiki treats the two as probably unrelated.

historical.leonard.name: Leonard
aliases: Author of Of Mountains and Seas

facts.occupation: Adventurer, mountaineer and inventor
facts.era: About 2,000 to 2,600 years ago, before Barbatos reshaped Mondstadt
facts.identity_notes: The wiki infobox lists him under the Adventurers' Guild, a modern organisation; his own era predates it, so this is not an in-world affiliation.

facts.occupation: Noblewoman who abandoned her house; fighter in Eduardo Baker's faction (axe)
facts.era: Before the cataclysm, around the Fleuve Cendre purge and the Siege of Poisson (over 500 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Her identification with Rosa Reed (wife of Thompson Reed in the Poisson photograph) is the wiki's deduction from two weapon texts, not an explicit statement. The weapon is a claymore; her own weapon in the text is an axe.

historical.lianca.name: Lianca
aliases: First Speaker of the Flower-Feather Clan
uncrowned princess of the Flower-Feather Clan

facts.title: First Speaker of the Flower-Feather Clan
facts.occupation: Founder and first leader of the Flower-Feather Clan; archer and staff fighter
facts.era: Time of the Grand Alliance and Ochkanatlan, about two thousand years before the present
facts.identity_notes: The weapon Chain Breaker is her bow, forged by the Second Sovereign Lord at the Eighth's request. The wiki describes her as an adult with blue eyes, a long brown braid and scars on her left cheek, left upper arm and right midriff, based on the Belonging cutscene.

facts.title: Archpriestess of Hyperborea
facts.species: Human (Frostmoon Scion by upbringing; an adopted outsider by birth, unknown to her)
facts.occupation: Last Archpriestess of the Frostmoon Scions
facts.era: About 500 years ago, before the Cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: Her name is struck from the public Frostmoon Scion record; only priestess-rank Scions are meant to know it. The Traveler and Paimon learned it through Aila's recordings.

historical.luther.name: Luther
aliases: Author of the Ancient Investigation Journals

facts.occupation: Member of an aristocratic household; expedition scribe and surveyor
facts.era: Aristocratic period, about 1,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: His name appears in the Ragged Records found in the Dragonspine ruins, which note that the writer of the second record did not finish Luther off. He is otherwise 'the author' of the Ancient Investigation Journals.

facts.title: Director of the Narzissenkreuz Institute; the Red Empress
facts.occupation: Orphanage director; later member of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Lyris ceased to exist as a separate person when she absorbed Mary-Ann Guillotin; the hybrid is a different entity (npc.mary-ann). Described as 'tall' and 'pure' by Mary-Ann.

facts.title: Priest-King; dragon slayer
facts.occupation: Attendant of the Holy Sovereign, travelling hero, founder and first priest-king of the Masters of the Night-Wind
facts.era: About 2,000 years ago, in the reigns of Xbalanque and Och-Kan
facts.identity_notes: Dinga was his name as the Holy Sovereign's servant; Maghan is the name of the hero and dragon slayer. Item text calls him an outlander never seen before in the valley.

facts.title: Queen-Regent
facts.occupation: Sword dancer; concubine, then queen-regent
facts.era: Several thousand years ago, after King Deshret's fall
facts.identity_notes: Not a modern or playable character. Known from weapon and artifact texts, an obelisk inscription and a Thoth slab; the wiki lists her title as 'Temptress of Woe'.

facts.title: God of Eternity; first Electro Archon
facts.occupation: Electro Archon and Raiden Shogun of Inazuma (about 2,000 to 500 years ago)
facts.era: Archon War; Electro Archon from the end of the Archon War (about 2,000 years ago) until her death in the cataclysm 500 years ago.
facts.identity_notes: Baal is Makoto's divine name; Ei's is Beelzebul. Because the twins ruled as one, 'Baal' and 'Raiden Shogun' referred to both of them, and Ei still rules under the name Baal. Most Inazumans never knew there were two.

historical.mallko.name: Mallko
aliases: Mallko of the Scions of the Canopy

facts.occupation: Scion of the Canopy; Night Warden Wars fighter
facts.era: Present-day Natlan; he died five years before the Archon Quests
facts.identity_notes: The wiki notes he shares a name with a figure in Inca mythology (trivia only).

facts.title: Champion Duelist
facts.occupation: Champion Duelist (spear); formerly a street fighter of Fleuve Cendre
facts.era: Before the cataclysm; the Siege of Poisson and after (over 500 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Dissolved in the Narzissenkreuz's waters; the weapon texts treat her consciousness as absorbed. The Rightful Reward description names her in-text only as 'the renowned Marfisa'; the wiki ties the spear-wielder of both weapon texts to her.

facts.occupation: Marechaussee Phantom agent
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Not the Oceanid Mary-Ann (npc.mary-ann) nor the dream-born Ann (npc.ann). The wiki says she is 'sometimes referred to as Ann'.

facts.title: Transcendence (meaning of the Ancient Name Vuka)
facts.occupation: Warrior and pilgrim of the Flower-Feather Clan; one of the six heroes of the war against the Abyss
facts.era: The cataclysm, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: The Flower-Wreathed Feathers text calls him the hero bearing the name Transcendence; the Ancient Name Vuka, now held by Chasca, was his. Whether he had a Vision is unclear, but he is shown controlling Pyro.

facts.title: General Kapisas
facts.occupation: Yaksha warrior in the service of Rex Lapis; clothing designer
facts.era: Archon War and the centuries after it
facts.identity_notes: Xiao gives the title 'General Kapisas' in the 2.7 quest At Tunnel's End, Light and again in 3.4. His element and the nickname 'Rock Yaksha' come from a voice actor's public statement as relayed by the wiki, not from in-game text.

facts.title: Tiger-Bite
facts.occupation: Oni warrior and ally of the Raiden Shogun
facts.era: about 500 years before the present (the cataclysm)
facts.identity_notes: Her story circulated as that of a male oni named Torachiyo; item texts say Torachiyo is a later corruption of 'Chiyo the Tiger-Bite'. She is an event NPC with only a few cinematic lines (5.4).

facts.title: Katsuragikiri (Katsuragi-Slashing); Inspector
facts.occupation: Inazuma Shogunate Inspector at Tatarasuna; amateur bladesmith; author of the Anthology of Inazuman Blades
facts.era: Lived around the cataclysm 500 years ago; the Tatarasuna Mystery happened about 400 years ago.
facts.identity_notes: Adopted into the Mikoshi Clan; the epithet 'Katsuragikiri' (Katsuragi-slashing) attaches to both him and the sword. Inagi Hotomi says most people surnamed Mikoshi in Inazuma City today are his descendants.

facts.title: Blood-Devourer
facts.occupation: King of the Volkodlak and head of the Miscislavli Alliance
facts.era: Reign of Monomakh Snezhnyi, about 3,000 years ago; died in the seventh year of the 428th Cycle
facts.identity_notes: His fae epithet Gorynishche means 'Son of the Mountain'; the wiki links it to the folk dragon Zmei Gorynych. The Volkhov Chronicles call him the Blood-Devourer.

facts.title: Mistress of Chenyu Vale
facts.occupation: Ruling god of Chizhang and Chenyu Vale; overseer of its beasts, spirits and adepti
facts.era: Archon War
facts.identity_notes: Her true name has been forgotten even by Chenyu Vale's people. 'Mistress of Chenyu Vale' is the English epithet (the Chinese name is rendered by the wiki as roughly 'former lord of Sunken-Jade Vale'). Fujin calls her 'our lord' and 'previous god'; the local book Mt. Lingmeng Gossip calls her a demon lord.

facts.occupation: Shrine maiden of Sangonomiya Shrine; whalesong master; commander of Watatsumi's first navy
facts.era: Archon War, the war between Orobashi and the Raiden Shogun
facts.identity_notes: The wiki glosses the Japanese name as 'Dark Cloud'; the in-game romanisation is Mouun. Her rank in the Yuna Clan is not given.

facts.title: Goddess of Flowers
facts.species: Angel (a divine envoy created by the Heavenly Principles), later called a god
facts.occupation: Goddess of Flowers; ruler of the ancient desert civilisation of Ay-Khanoum alongside King Deshret; possibly once a Moon Envoy of the Lunar Palace (wiki inference)
facts.era: Archon War era and earlier; killed in the ancient desert kingdom thousands of years before the present.
facts.identity_notes: In Chinese-language text she is the 'Goddess/God of Flowers'; the English localisation also uses 'Lord of Flowers' and 'God King'. Item text calls her the Moon Maiden. 'Bilqis' in the quest series title The Dirge of Bilqis is a name from real-world tradition; the wiki treats Nabu Malikata as its analogue, but the quests do not use it as her in-game name.

historical.nameless-bard.name: Nameless Bard
aliases: the young bard of Old Mondstadt
the lad living in that storm-shrouded city

facts.occupation: Bard; leader of the rebellion against Decarabian
facts.era: Old Mondstadt, about 2,600 years before the present, during the Archon War
facts.identity_notes: Canon never gives his name in one plain line. The wiki lists 'Venti' as his real name based on A Note in Spring's Leich (6.3) and Venti's Character Story 4; treat it as strongly supported, not stated.

historical.narzissenkreuz.name: Narzissenkreuz
aliases: Incomplete Order of the New Cosmos

facts.title: Incomplete Order of the New Cosmos
facts.species: Made being: a Hydro Tulpa formed from Oceanid essence and Abyssal remains (exact nature disputed)
facts.occupation: Leader ('Master') of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo
facts.era: About 400 years before the main story (the Ordo's heyday and fall)
facts.identity_notes: Narzissenkreuz is the name of the made being, not of the man Rene de Petrichor whose mind it carries. Canon gives no age or birthday for either.

facts.occupation: Warrior; guardian of a human clan
facts.era: Before the Archon War, in the youth of Monomakh and Filipov
facts.identity_notes: Appears only in a legend-style book account as told by chroniclers; not met in person.

facts.title: Dragon King
facts.occupation: Original ruler of Teyvat; King of all Dragon Lords
facts.era: Before the Heavenly Principles to the war of funerary flame (about 6,000 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Counted as the Second Descender even though he was Teyvat's native ruler; Aksinya calls him the true Primordial Human (Narayana). Never seen alive on screen; known only from murals, books, item texts and testimony.

facts.title: Corporal (Kapral)
facts.occupation: Fatui corporal
facts.era: recent; the Chasm operation shortly before the Traveler's arrival in Liyue
facts.identity_notes: Affectionately called Kolya. Never seen alive; known from his sister, a diary and a letter. His death is presumed rather than shown.

facts.title: Armory Officer of Mikage Furnace
facts.occupation: Armory Officer and swordsmith of Mikage Furnace; head and successor of the Niwa Clan
facts.era: About 400 years before the present (the Tatarasuna Mystery)
facts.identity_notes: Usually called simply 'Niwa'. The Niwa Clan is one of the three clans of the Isshin Art (the Isshin Sansaku, with the Akame and Kaedehara clans).

historical.och-kan.name: Och-Kan
aliases: Dragon of the City of Flowing Ash

facts.title: Sacred Lord
facts.species: Half-dragon (a dragon with a human soul)
facts.occupation: Python King and Sacred Lord of Ochkanatlan; Grand Alliance ruler
facts.era: The age of the Grand Alliance in ancient Natlan, after Xbalanque became the first Pyro Archon
facts.identity_notes: 'Cocouik' ('Coco') is the name Bona gave to his separated mind; the 'Dragon of the City of Flowing Ash' is his Abyss-corrupted body. Both are Och-Kan.

facts.title: Shah
facts.occupation: Shepherd turned vassal-king of Gurabad
facts.era: Early vassal-king age of King Deshret's civilization, thousands of years ago
facts.identity_notes: Spelling varies: Ormazd or Ohrmazd. Called 'Ormazd Shah' in The Tale of Shiruyeh and Shirin.

facts.title: Watatsumi Omikami
facts.occupation: Guardian deity of Enkanomiya and Watatsumi Island
facts.era: Archon War (c. 2,000 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: 'Orobashi no Mikoto' is the Japanese-style name; 'Orobaxi' is the Chinese phonetic spelling used by many NPC lines. 'Watatsumi Omikami' (Great God of the Sea) is his title as the god of Watatsumi. Sources differ between he and it: the Preliminary Study and the Oathsworn Eye text say 'he', while the Shogun's voice-over, the Sangonomiya Chronicles and several item texts say 'it'.

facts.occupation: Mechanic and workshop owner
facts.era: Present day; died before the events of Version 6.0
facts.identity_notes: Papa Wrench is the name he took after amnesia; his real surname is Shesternin.

facts.title: Phantom Thief
facts.occupation: noble heir turned vigilante thief; later Chief Mate to the Skipper
facts.era: Aristocratic period, roughly a thousand years before the main story
facts.identity_notes: Not the Fontainian magician Parsifal the Great (historical.parsifal-the-great), whose stage name was inspired by a play about him. No family name is given in canon.

facts.title: Great Magician
facts.occupation: Stage magician and thief; later a member of Eduardo Baker's circle at Poisson
facts.era: Before the cataclysm; the Siege of Poisson and after (over 500 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: 'Parsifal' is a stage name. The wiki notes that the one who fought Marfisa may have been her sister Josephine using the alias.

facts.title: Spirit of Victory
facts.occupation: Conqueror, then vassal king of Gurabad
facts.era: Vassal-king age of King Deshret's civilization, thousands of years ago
facts.identity_notes: Born Kisra; named Parvez by Ormazd; added 'Ravan' on becoming king. Eremite histories call him both a great hero and a tyrant.

facts.occupation: Yaksha
facts.era: the Archon War, over a thousand years ago (wiki phrasing)
facts.identity_notes: Named Pervases by Rex Lapis himself. His human form is shown only in the quest; in-game his temple holds a crane statue. Chinese name 铜雀 (Copper Sparrow).

facts.title: Protector of Justice (also given as Protector of Order)
facts.occupation: Marechaussee Hunter; night-time vigilante
facts.era: Roughly twenty years before the present (the vigilante era Furina recalls)
facts.identity_notes: Known only through other people's accounts, chiefly Clorinde's. No voiced appearance.

facts.title: Discordant Symphony; Grand Symphony
facts.species: Artificial system; a Symphony made from Sybilla
facts.era: Remuria; resurfaces in Version 4.6
facts.identity_notes: Not a person in the usual sense. Its voice in the modern quests is the fragmentary 'Boethius' it wears.

facts.title: Herbad
facts.occupation: Scholar of Kshahrewar; researcher of the Ruin Golem
facts.era: Sometime after the Cataclysm five hundred years ago; exact period not given
facts.identity_notes: Referred to as 'Nara Pir Kavikavus' by Aranara. 'Pir' is the first part of his name, not a rank. The annual Pir Kavikavus Prize honours scholars under forty.

facts.occupation: Researcher of the Fatui's Armory Palace
facts.era: Before the events of Colors of Emptiness (Nod-Krai); exact date not given
facts.identity_notes: Only the initials V. A. are given; the wiki lists him among the Snowland Fae.

facts.occupation: painter of prophetic frescoes; daughter of the high priest
facts.era: Era of the unified civilisation (several thousand years ago, before the Archon War)
facts.identity_notes: Her name is never given in canon. Frostbearer's English text calls her the daughter of 'the priestess of Vindagnyr'; the Chinese original is gender-neutral for the priest, and every other source makes her father Varuch.

facts.occupation: servant to Eberhart; his co-conspirator
facts.era: Aristocratic period, during the fall of the aristocracy in Vennessa's time
facts.identity_notes: Her background is not given. Only her given name is known.

facts.title: Grand Duke; Governor of Nod-Krai
facts.occupation: Governor of Nod-Krai
facts.era: Before and during the Cataclysm, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: His forename Prokhor is inferred by the wiki from Brahe's patronymic Prokhorovitch and a fictionalised character name in a Reed Miller story.

facts.title: Dawn Knight
facts.occupation: knight's squire, later knight; rebel; tender of the Dawn Winery
facts.era: Aristocratic period, about 1,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: 'Ragnvindr' is the only name given. 'Dawn Knight' is a title he chose for himself in honour of the Dawnlight Swordswoman.

facts.title: Knight of Boreas
facts.occupation: blacksmith's son; second Knight of Boreas; knight
facts.era: Mondstadt, some years after the Wandering Knight's departure and before Arundolyn's and Rostam's time
facts.identity_notes: Not to be confused with the nameless Wandering Knight (the first Knight of Boreas). His surname, age and appearance are never given.

facts.occupation: wandering warrior; rebel organiser
facts.era: Archon War, about 2,600 years ago
facts.identity_notes: His name was lost to time (Windblume Ode). 'Red-Haired Warrior' is what the game's texts call him; Freedom-Sworn says 'flame-haired warrior' and Dawn's Brilliant Oath says 'warrior clad in iron'.

facts.title: Great Tengu of Mt. Yougou
facts.occupation: Chieftain of the Yougou Tengu; mentor; bodyguard of the Kitsune Saiguu
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about five hundred years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Japanese name given as 霊善坊. Her only known child is Teruyo; no first or family name is stated.

facts.title: Sebastos
facts.occupation: God King and Sebastos of Remuria; formerly a 'singer of the oases' in Sumeru
facts.era: Remuria, thousands of years before the present (exact date not stated)
facts.identity_notes: Remuria is named for him. 'Sebastos' is the title Remurians use. 'Fortuna' was originally a byname for destiny and is now remembered as the name of his ship.

facts.title: Mayor of Poisson; last patrono of the de Petrichor line
facts.occupation: Ruler of Petrichor, then mayor of Poisson
facts.era: The cataclysm, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Known only through a photograph description, an NPC's account and Rene's writings. Not the same person as his son Rene.

facts.occupation: Scholar and researcher; founder of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about 500 years before the present; the Ordo was founded more than 400 years ago
facts.identity_notes: 'Rene' is also spelled 'René' in other languages. After dissolving himself he continues only as the being Narzissenkreuz (the Master).

facts.title: Bloodstained Knight
facts.occupation: Knight of Favonius (later wandering monster-slayer; sworn to the Abyss)
facts.era: Mondstadt, around the cataclysm 500 years before the main story
facts.identity_notes: 'Roland' is his only name. 'White Knight' was his original title; 'Bloodstained Knight' replaced it. The 'Roland' met in the Lupus Majoris Chapter is an imitation cast by the Abyss, not the man himself. The wiki lists his two weapons as the sword Durandarte (shown as a claymore appearance in 6.4) and the Black Sword.

facts.occupation: Exorcist who took part in the cataclysm-era defence of The Chasm
facts.era: Cataclysm, about five hundred years ago
facts.identity_notes: Canon names him only in Boyang's notes and dialogue. Whether Rongzhao himself was a Millelith soldier is not stated; he is described as an exorcist and the younger brother of a Millelith thaumaturge.

facts.title: Wolf Pup
facts.occupation: Knight of Favonius; Knight of Boreas; deputy to the Grand Master
facts.era: Mondstadt, around the cataclysm 500 years before the main story
facts.identity_notes: 'Rostam' is his only given name. He is known only through item texts and the 6.4 Varka quests; he has no model and no on-screen appearance, only a voice heard as a 'longing' attached to his sword. No source states that he lacked a Vision; he is simply never shown with one.

facts.title: Doge
facts.occupation: Scholar; first Doge of Petrichor and founder of the Consilium Sapientium
facts.era: Several hundred years before the present, after the cataclysm of about 500 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Known through his own notes, Petrichor's lore and Bravais's annotation.

facts.title: Stranger of Winter's Day
facts.era: More than 6,000 years ago, during the era of the unified civilization (the exact date of his death is not stated)
facts.identity_notes: Known in canon as the Third Descender; 'Saarelainen' and 'Stranger of Winter's Day' are the names used in the Hymns of the Far North and the wiki's profile. The Heavenly Principles erased him from Irminsul, so the name survives mainly in Nod-Krai's hymns and the memory of the Belyi Tsar.

historical.sakkuk.name: Sakkuk
aliases: Chief of the Children of Echoes

facts.title: Peace-Reforger
facts.occupation: Hero of the rebellion against Och-Kan; later Chief of the Children of Echoes
facts.era: About 2,000 years ago, in the age of Och-Kan and the second Pyro Archon
facts.identity_notes: Bearer of the Ancient Name Baraka (now held by Xilonen). The wiki gives 'Peace-Reforger' and 'Chief of the Children of Echoes' as her titles; her gender is clear in the item texts (she/her).

facts.title: Border Master
facts.occupation: Warrior, high priest, border master and storyteller
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Companion: the Iktomisaurus Mahamba. Also titled Grand Master in a Vucub Caquix Tower note (per the wiki). Shown with the bow Chain Breaker in battle, though that weapon is otherwise tied to the Flower-Feather Clan.

facts.title: Great Tengu of Yougou
facts.occupation: General in the Raiden Shogun's service
facts.era: The war against Orobashi, centuries before the game's present
facts.identity_notes: The name is Japanese for the bamboo lily. Canon text read here never states pronouns; avoid assigning them.

facts.title: Pyro Archon
facts.occupation: Second Pyro Archon, God of War
facts.era: About 2,000 years ago, the time of Och-Kan's rule
facts.identity_notes: His name was deliberately removed from history at his request. Haborym is the divine name; an item text implies it is shared by Pyro Archons generally, not unique to him.

facts.title: Fell Dragon Prince
facts.species: Hydro vishap of the Dragonborn, styled a fell dragon; now a soul dwelling in Ichor
facts.occupation: Prince of the Dragonborn vishaps; formerly guard of Egeria's prison
facts.era: Remurian era (about two thousand years before the present, per the wiki)
facts.identity_notes: Cassiodor says 'fell dragon' was only the Remurians' name for an unusually strong vishap, since no new Hydro Dragon could be born while Egeria hibernated. A weapon legend calls Scylla a Dragon King; the quests and Scylla himself use only 'Prince'.

historical.sea-gazer.name: Sea Gazer
aliases: Perfected Lord Who Resounds in Sea and Lives in Rosy Clouds

facts.title: Perfected Lord Who Resounds in Sea and Lives in Rosy Clouds
facts.occupation: Adeptus, explorer and collector of treasures
facts.era: Archon War era or earlier; exact period unstated
facts.identity_notes: Known only by this epithet. The longer title is the literal rendering of his Chinese name (Minghai Qixia Zhenjun) as listed in the wiki language table.

facts.title: Demon Queen
facts.occupation: Queen of Gurabad
facts.era: Centuries before King Deshret's fall; the age of the vassal kings
facts.identity_notes: Not the forest-ranger NPC also named Shirin. The wiki lists the epithet Demon Queen from popular legend. She, her husband and her son Shiruyeh all vanish with Gurabad.

facts.species: Divine bird, a body formed from Khvarena
facts.occupation: Guardian of the border between new birth and death
facts.era: Before and during the cataclysm, roughly 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Simurgh is a divine bird, not a human. Her Khvarena survives scattered as countless motes, the Pari among them.

facts.occupation: Sea captain and hunter of sea monsters
facts.era: About one thousand years ago
facts.identity_notes: His real name is not given anywhere. 'Skipper' is a title, and the book Tales From the Waves puts the word in quotation marks.

historical.skybracer.name: Skybracer
aliases: The Perfected Lord who Moves the Heavens by Guiding the Sky

facts.title: Yixiao Daotian Zhenjun (the Perfected Lord who Moves the Heavens by Guiding the Sky)
facts.occupation: Adeptus who fought in the Archon War
facts.era: Archon War (thousands of years before the present)
facts.identity_notes: Known only through Lantern Rite (1.3) dialogue and the Mingxiao Lantern modelled on him; no profile or quest of his own exists. His sacred name is given in Chinese on the wiki and the English 'Skybracer' is the in-game name of both the figure and the lantern.

facts.title: Dastur
facts.occupation: Dastur and field researcher of the Amurta Darshan
facts.era: about 400 years ago, after the cataclysm of 500 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Her gender is not stated outright in English text; the wiki infers 'she' from the female-exclusive character in her Chinese name. Treat she/her as a well-supported reading, not a quoted line.

historical.sojourner.name: Sojourner
aliases: the traveler of the Wanderer's Troupe

facts.occupation: Wandering lyrist and archer; warrior-musician
facts.era: About a thousand years ago, in the time of Mondstadt's aristocracy
facts.identity_notes: No personal name is given in canon. 'Sojourner' is a community name taken from the Resolution of Sojourner artifact set; item texts call him the traveler, lyrist or harpist. He is the first wielder of The Stringless.

facts.title: Torchforger
facts.occupation: Noble and general; founder and first Starshyna of the Lightkeepers
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about five hundred years before the present
facts.identity_notes: 'Silve' is the short form Avrelian (as 'Relya') uses in the youth flashback of The Raven's Legacy (6.3). Brahe's notes call him Silvestr.

facts.title: Goddess of the Iridescent Moon
facts.occupation: Goddess of the Iridescent Moon, one of the Three Moons' sovereigns
facts.era: Primordial Teyvat; the war of funerary flame; the Crimson Moon Dynasty of Khaenri'ah
facts.identity_notes: 'Sonnet' is her name as a goddess; the Khaenri'ahn dynasty worshiped her remains as the Crimson Moon.

facts.occupation: Conspirator and agitator of the 'old regime'
facts.era: About four hundred years before the present, in the early days of Melusines living in the Court of Fontaine
facts.identity_notes: Appears only as a named speaker in a memory replayed from the Fountain of Lucine during the quest Ever-Surging Memories (4.1). The wiki has no profile text for her; the pronoun comes from the quest's scene directions. Her name may echo the historical Suavegotha, a Burgundian princess and queen (wiki trivia, not canon).

historical.sundjatta.name: Sundjatta
aliases: 52nd Chief of the Children of Echoes

facts.title: Chief of the Children of Echoes
facts.occupation: Chief of the Children of Echoes and warrior; smith-scholar
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about 500 years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Companion: the Stegosaurus Muhuru. Shown wielding a heavy bludgeoning weapon and manipulating Geo in the Sunset short; canon does not say whether he held a Vision.

facts.title: Golden Bee
facts.species: Angel (Celestia's envoy); later a golden bee
facts.occupation: Envoy guarding the Irminsul tree at Meropis; prophet of Remuria
facts.era: Unified civilization / Remurian era
facts.identity_notes: Sybilla is the Angel's name; 'Golden Bee' is both her title and the form in which Remus found her. Canon also shows golden bees as guides without saying they are all her.

facts.title: Lord Taika
facts.occupation: Warrior; leader of the Ochkanatlan Adventure Team
facts.era: About a decade after the Cataclysm began; hundreds of years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Players know him only from artifact text, the Moment of Awakening memory and a line in Twisted Extension; he has no on-screen present-day appearance. 'Ochkanatlan Adventure Team' is an unofficial name.

facts.title: The Mistsplitter
facts.occupation: Swordsman; Hatamoto of the Shogun
facts.era: Cataclysm era, about five hundred years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Takamine is his surname according to Hibiki's narration in the Hamayumi text; no first name is given. 'Konbumaru' (from konbu, kelp, plus the name suffix maru) is a nickname given by the Tengu and Hibiki. Japanese: 霧切高嶺 (Kirigiri Takamine).

facts.title: God of the Underworld
facts.species: God; had the form of a giant tree
facts.occupation: God who pacified the forces of life and death, standing before the realm of the dead
facts.era: Before and during the Archon War
facts.identity_notes: Tao Dou is the name used in Liyue legend (the opera 'The Sanctification of Tao Dou'); Bune is its divine name. The name is also used for the mountain where the Three Beasts of Tao Dou retreated.

facts.title: Tenoyollotzin
facts.occupation: Warrior; organiser of the Heroes of Natlan during the cataclysm
facts.era: The cataclysm, about 500 years before the present of Natlan's Archon Quest
facts.identity_notes: 'Tenoyollotzin' is a respectful title (per the resort manager Pucli in a world quest: 'the honored heart of Tenochtzitoc'). He had lost his Ancient Name before he died. Reach him only through legend and memory scenes.

facts.species: Human (Khaenri'ahn); now a soul without a body
facts.occupation: Moon Marrow researcher at the Universitas Magistrorum
facts.era: Khaenri'ah, shortly before the Cataclysm (about 500 years before the present)
facts.identity_notes: Appears only in memories (A Nation That Doesn't Exist, An Elegy for Faded Moonlight) and as a soul in the moon's reflection (True Moon). Her body was destroyed on entering the reflection; her soul persists there.

historical.tupac.name: Tupac
aliases: Giant of the People of the Springs

facts.title: Giant
facts.occupation: Warrior of the People of the Springs; one of the six heroes of the cataclysm
facts.era: Cataclysm, 500 years before the present day
facts.identity_notes: Bearer of the Ancient Name Umoja ('unity') during the cataclysm; the Name was later inherited by Mualani. The wiki records that he was shown controlling Hydro in the 'Sunset' short; no Vision is shown.

facts.title: Treader of the Rainbow
facts.occupation: Warrior-hero; one of the original Six Heroes of Natlan
facts.era: Age of Xbalanque and the Grand Alliance, long before the cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: First known bearer of the Ancient Name Umoja ('unity'). Also called the Rainbow King in the Footprint of the Rainbow text. The wiki lists him as deceased in the past, but canon does not state how he died; one legend has him reunited with his beloved across the sea.

facts.occupation: Probably the scribe of Sal Vindagnyr
facts.era: Thousands of years ago, during the final days of Sal Vindagnyr
facts.identity_notes: Ukko is named only in the Princess' Box text. That Ukko is the scribe who speaks in the Scribe's Box and the Ancient Carvings is an inference by the wiki, based on the absence of other contemporary figures. Canon gives no gender in the sources read.

facts.occupation: Slave gladiator
facts.era: About a thousand years ago, in the time of Mondstadt's aristocracy
facts.identity_notes: Never named. He is the subject of the Gladiator's Finale artifact set and is linked to the polearm Deathmatch by the wiki; the item text says only that the weapon bore witness to 'a certain gladiator'.

facts.occupation: Author, tea connoisseur and storyteller; swordmaker
facts.era: Before and during the cataclysm era, about five hundred years ago; memory resurfaced in the present day (2.5)
facts.identity_notes: Japanese: 有楽斎. He was called 'Yuurakusai' in the English text until version 2.5, when the name was changed to Urakusai. He appears as a Quest NPC, and his memory speaks only through the Traveler's body. Wiki trivia links the name to Oda Nagamasu, who also used the name Urakusai and was a tea master; this is a real-world allusion.

facts.occupation: Priest of Sal Vindagnyr (wiki: likely its last king-priest)
facts.era: Thousands of years before the present; the era of the Celestial Nails, before the Archon War
facts.identity_notes: Known only through the Priest's Box and the daughter's texts; no quest, voice-over or profile exists for him.

historical.vaselisa-von-strivozha.name: Vaselisa von Strivozha
aliases: Lady of the Vila of Veneter

facts.title: The Pure One
facts.occupation: First Grand Duchess of the Vila; ruler of the Silver Court of Veneter
facts.era: About 3,000 years ago, during the wars between the Pale Star Court and the Miscislavli Alliance
facts.identity_notes: 'Sword Saint' is a title the wiki cites to the Traveler's voice-over about the Belyi Tsar; it was not re-checked here.

facts.title: Special Security and Surveillance Captain
facts.occupation: Captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol; later prisoner and founder of the Mutual Aid Network
facts.era: About 400 years before the present, per quest dialogue and the wiki
facts.identity_notes: Appears only in the memory of Neuvillette in Ever-Surging Memories, in a cutscene of In a New Light, and in Wriothesley's account; there is no living Vautrin in the game.

facts.occupation: Leader of the Lawrence Clan
facts.era: Early Aristocratic Period, about 2,600 years ago, soon after Barbatos became the Anemo Archon
facts.identity_notes: Her name is a Latin verb form meaning to revere or worship. The roughly 2,600-year dating is the wiki's reasoning; the texts give no date.

facts.title: Falcon of the West
facts.species: Human (Muratan); said to have ascended to Celestia
facts.occupation: Slave gladiator; rebellion leader; first Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius
facts.era: About 1,000 years before the present day (the Aristocratic period of Mondstadt)
facts.identity_notes: Her foreign roots are stated in game: the song The Legend of Vennessa says she hailed from the southern plains, Aquila Favonia credits the blessing of Favonius to a distant tribe, and Shackles of the Dandelion Gladiator mentions the divine flame of her ancestral home. The Muratan name comes from the official manga; the 5.8 quest The Last Survivor of Tenochtzitoc has Enjou say that Natlanese exiles who went to the land of wind were known there as Muratans. Her sister Lind and the detailed arena story come from the official manga, not from the game itself.

facts.title: Lord of the Forest
facts.occupation: First lord of the forest, ruler of the labyrinth's animals
facts.era: founding of Dharma Forest, after Rukkhadevata parted from King Deshret
facts.identity_notes: English text calls Viaghara 'it' or 'him' inconsistently. The name is read as derived from the Sanskrit vyaghra, 'tiger'. 'Viaghara' names the first lord; later lords of the forest are unnamed.

facts.title: Knight of Boreas
facts.occupation: wandering knight; first Knight of Boreas
facts.era: Mondstadt, about 1000 years before the main story, in Vennessa's time
facts.identity_notes: His name is lost. 'Wandering Knight' is the name used for him in Lupus Majoris Chapter credits and dialogue; 'Wolf Knight' and 'Knight of Boreas' are the titles in item texts. In Mondstadt's tales he is nameless, and in some tellings called Andrius.

facts.title: the great runner
facts.occupation: Warrior of the Collective of Plenty; one of the six heroes of the cataclysm
facts.era: Cataclysm, 500 years before the present day
facts.identity_notes: Bearer of the Ancient Name Uwezo ('power') in the cataclysm; the Name now belongs to Iansan. The wiki records that she was shown controlling Electro in the 'Sunset' short; no Vision is shown.

historical.waskar.name: Waskar
aliases: the younger of the twin heroes

facts.occupation: Hero; champion in the war against the king of Ochkanatlan
facts.era: The age of the heroes' revolt that ended the kingdom of Ochkanatlan, long before the Cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: Known only through Unfinished Reverie artifact text; no profile, dialogue or voice. Called the younger of the twin heroes.

historical.xbalanque.name: Xbalanque
aliases: One Entombed With the Primal Fire

facts.title: First Pyro Archon
facts.occupation: First Pyro Archon and God of War of Natlan (deceased)
facts.era: About 2,000 years ago, at the end of the Archon War
facts.identity_notes: Haborym is his divine name; Kiongozi ('Leader') is his Ancient Name, later inherited by Mavuika. He calls himself 'Dear Beloved Sun' and says friends may call him 'Lanque'. In 5.3 he appeared only while possessing the body of a sickly tribal boy, Mausau.

facts.title: Blade of Tulaytullah
facts.occupation: Warrior and hero of Tulaytullah; formerly a disguised crown prince and apprentice of the Old Blind Poet
facts.era: the age of the desert city-states after King Deshret's kingdom fell, thousands of years ago
facts.identity_notes: Known from weapon-flavour legends (Xiphos' Moonlight, Key of Khaj-Nisut, Tulaytullah's Remembrance); these are in-world stories whose details vary between tellers. The sword blade named after him is a Jinni-haunted blade, not the Key of Khaj-Nisut.

facts.title: Pyro Dragon Sovereign
facts.species: Dragon (Pyro Dragon Sovereign, one of the Seven Sovereigns)
facts.occupation: Sovereign of Natlantea, the ancient dragon civilisation of Natlan
facts.era: Age of the Seven Sovereigns through the fall of Tollan (about 2,000 years before the present)
facts.identity_notes: He never speaks on-screen; everything known comes from Kukulkan, records, item texts and visions. The Lord of Eroded Primal Fire is Gosoythoth wearing his form, not Xiuhcoatl himself.

historical.yalyane-morevna.name: Yalyane Morevna
aliases: the crimson princess of the snow

facts.title: Knyazhna of Blood
facts.species: Snegovik (snow fae); described as the first of her kind
facts.occupation: Princess of the Snegovik; spear instructor
facts.era: After the fall of Hyperborea and before the Belyi Tsar founded Kitezh
facts.identity_notes: Yalyane is a Nenets-derived first name (the wiki glosses it 'maiden of light'); Morevna is a patronymic style. 'Knyazhna' is a Slavic word for a prince's daughter, so her title means roughly 'Princess of Blood'.

facts.occupation: Former Fatui (Fatuus); cultivator of the Auguste flower under the cover identity 'Vijava'
facts.era: About 20 years before the Pomum de Ambra Chapter (Fontaine's 'Perfume Mania')
facts.identity_notes: Posed as a Sumeru scholar called Vijava while in Fontaine.

historical.yun-huang.name: Yun Huang
aliases: eighth head of the Yun Family

facts.title: Eighth head of the Yun Family
facts.occupation: Weaponsmith; head of the Yun Family forge; martial artist
facts.era: About 500 years before the present (the Cataclysm and its aftermath)
facts.identity_notes: Known only through Blackcliff weapon descriptions. Death is not described; she is listed as dead because she lived five hundred years ago.

historical.yun-hui.name: Yun Hui
aliases: seventh head of the Yun Family

facts.title: Seventh head of the Yun Family
facts.occupation: Master weaponsmith; later a member of the Liyue Qixing
facts.era: About 500 years before the present (the Cataclysm and its aftermath)
facts.identity_notes: Known only through weapon descriptions (Prototype Amber, Blackcliff Longsword, Blackcliff Warbow). Death is not described; he is long dead by the passage of time.

facts.title: Firethief
facts.occupation: Warrior; ordnance officer of the Grand Alliance
facts.era: Ancient Natlan, from the age of Xbalanque's journey to the fall of Ochkanatlan under the Grand Alliance
facts.identity_notes: Yupanqui is a mentioned figure only: he never appears in person. 'Firethief' and 'Fire-Bringer' are the Scions of the Canopy's epithets for him; the wiki infers he was the first bearer of the Ancient Name Malipo.

facts.title: Verdant Lord
facts.species: Human (presumed; canon does not state otherwise)
facts.occupation: Ruler over several city-states of the Great Red Sand
facts.era: Thousands of years before the present; in the period of the Deys of Orghana
facts.identity_notes: Known only from Primal Obelisk inscriptions.

npc.acatl.name: Acatl
aliases: Chief of the Collective of Plenty

facts.title: Chief of the Collective of Plenty
facts.occupation: Chief of the Collective of Plenty; masked wrestler
facts.identity_notes: Name derives from the Nahuatl word for 'reed' (wiki etymology note). No Vision is shown in canon.

facts.title: Benevolent Knight
facts.occupation: Captain of the Knights of Favonius 5th Company (semi-retired)
facts.identity_notes: Canon names only 'Adorno'. Elderly and long-serving, but no age is stated. Fought with a bow (Lohen's profile has him say 'as an archer'; the 5th Company is the ranged company).

facts.occupation: Messenger bird and companion of Illuga
facts.identity_notes: Once Solovei's bird, carried across about five hundred years by the Sampo Mill.

facts.title: Almighty Dragonlord (self-proclaimed)
facts.species: Artificial intelligence (Sovereign Lord), projected as a pixelated dragon
facts.occupation: Kinich's contractual companion
facts.era: Natlantea (dragon era), more than 2,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: 'K'uhul Ajaw' (Divine Lord) is the name he gives; his original identity is not stated outright. The Tenth Lord, Aj Imuch' Paxlaq Lahun, is the best-supported match.

npc.aksinya.name: Aksinya
aliases: Court Jester of the Belyi Tsar

facts.title: Court Jester
facts.occupation: Court Jester of the Belyi Tsar; head of the Hvergelmir research institute
facts.era: Pre-Cataclysm Snezhnaya (about 500 years before the main story)
facts.identity_notes: Wields Cryo through a staff, not a Vision. Her years in the Shadow Realm kept her from aging, so a roughly five-hundred-year gap leaves her looking young; canon gives no numeric age.

npc.alice.name: Alice
aliases: Mother of the Most Adorable Klee

facts.title: Crimson Chronicle
facts.species: Long-lived elf-eared people (race unnamed in canon), like her daughter
facts.occupation: Adventurer, polymath witch, author of the Teyvat Travel Guide
facts.identity_notes: Codename 'A' in the Hexenzirkel. Long heard only as a voice or through objects (a phonograph, a Dodoco, a lantern); her body appeared in the Nod-Krai preview teaser and in game in Ripples That Will Never Reach (6.2).

facts.title: Spantamad Sage
facts.occupation: Sage of the Spantamad Darshan
facts.identity_notes: He tells the group not to be fooled by his age, so he is older, but no number is given. His residence is assumed to be the Akademiya in Sumeru City; canon does not state it.

facts.title: Elder of the Flower-Feather Clan
facts.occupation: Elder of the Flower-Feather Clan; Qucusaur rider and flying-trial organiser; later inventor of the Phlogiston Wings and failed usurper
facts.identity_notes: She wore a mask and took her dead son's name, Tepal, as the 'mastermind' of the Phlogiston Wings scheme; many in the tribe did not know she was behind it until the showdown.

npc.amina.name: Amina
aliases: Chief of the People of the Springs

facts.title: Chief of the People of the Springs
facts.occupation: Chief of the People of the Springs
facts.identity_notes: Succeeded her grandfather (unnamed in canon) after the tribe's elders voted for her. The name echoes a historical Hausa figure per the wiki etymology note.

facts.title: Manager, Northland Bank
facts.occupation: Manager / account manager of the Northland Bank's Liyue Harbor branch
facts.identity_notes: Russian-style name (wiki: Andrey). The wiki calls him tall but gives no figure; no height or age is stated.

npc.andrius.name: Andrius
aliases: Great Wolf King of the North

facts.title: Wolf of the North
facts.species: Wolf spirit; a wolf from Snezhnaya made a god by Koitar's blessing; no physical body since about a thousand years ago
facts.occupation: God of the north wind and protector of Wolvendom's wolf packs
facts.era: Archon War; Age of Kings; Mondstadt's Aristocracy era onwards
facts.identity_notes: Boreas (the title and name given by Koitar) and Andrius (the divine name) are the same being; the weekly-boss challenge is labelled 'Boreas' the first time (Razor's Story Quest) and 'Andrius' afterwards; quest dialogue names the Wolvendom spirit 'Boreas' and, in 6.4, the Nod-Krai remnant 'Andrius'. His physical body died and a remnant spirit watches over Wolvendom; another remnant was in Nod-Krai (resolved in 6.4).

facts.occupation: Traveller; former 'Knight' of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team (a storybook role)
facts.identity_notes: Not a person who existed before the Mary-Ann Oceanid dreamed her; she shares memories with Mary-Ann Guillotin and Lyris. Her human form resembles Mary-Ann Guillotin when young. Do not confuse her with Mary-Ann Guillotin, with the Oceanid Mary-Ann she lives with, or with Lyris.

facts.title: Transgressor
facts.species: Human (Byakuyakoku); now a Sinshade (Shade of Tokoyo) afterimage
facts.occupation: Apprentice Jibashiri
facts.era: Byakuyakoku, shortly before Enkanomiya's last day
facts.identity_notes: 'Antei' is the Narukami Island-style rendering of his name, Antigonus; the books also give 'Antigone'.
Anthon and Tonia are both derived from Anthony (wiki etymology note). Tartaglia calls him a kid; exact age is not stated. Treat as a child and keep all portrayal factual and non-sexual.

facts.title: Dendro Dragon
facts.occupation: Dendro Dragon Sovereign
facts.era: age of the dragons
facts.identity_notes: Neither the 3.6 quests nor the 6.6 Archon Quests give a personal name beyond Apep. Chinese text uses 'it' (它); English dialogue (e.g. Paimon in The Last Day of Remuria, Sobek and Thoth in 6.6) uses 'she'. She is voiced in quests (EN: Lauren Landa) but has no character voice-over set.

facts.occupation: Shimti tribesman; composes songs
facts.era: Nefer's childhood, some years before the Aaru Village scene
facts.identity_notes: Do not confuse with the dragon Apep (npc.apep). His fate is not shown in canon.

At the end of Aranyaka he turns into a seed and grows into the new Ashvattha Tree. Canon treats this as the final stage of an Aranara's life, not an ordinary death; the wiki lists him as deceased. The wiki uses 'he' in its first paragraph and 'it' later; quests use no pronoun, so 'he' is a convention.

facts.occupation: Pet cat; sits on the Curatorium of Secrets counter
facts.identity_notes: A descendant of the pet cats the Ibis King once raised, according to the wiki profile (sourced to the quest Headlong Into the Sands); listed as an open-world NPC of the Curatorium of Secrets.

facts.title: Ruler of Space
facts.occupation: Ruler of Space (absent from her post)
facts.identity_notes: Unnamed on screen in 1.0, where she is the 'unknown god' who calls herself the sustainer of heavenly principles; the name Asmoday and the title Ruler of Space come from later material. She has abandoned Celestia's meetings and her Temple of Space; her current location is unknown as of 7.1.

facts.title: Candlekeeper
facts.occupation: Veteran warrior and patrol guard of the People of the Springs
facts.identity_notes: Called 'Auntie Atea' by younger tribe members.

facts.occupation: Northland Bank employee; vault inventory clerk
facts.identity_notes: Romanised 'Avaz'; the voice files name him 'abaza'. His wiki profile and appearance sections are still empty.

facts.title: Grand Sage (former)
facts.occupation: former Grand Sage of the Sumeru Akademiya and Sage of the Rtawahist Darshan
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC (Chapter III). Left the Akademiya's posts when removed; sentence of lifelong 'cultivation of wisdom' in Avidya Forest. No Vision is ever shown. No present-day appearance after 3.2; the 3.3 Interlude shows him in a flashback.

facts.title: Geo Dragon
facts.species: Dragon (Geo/Earth Dragon Sovereign; Ancient Geovishap Ancestor)
facts.occupation: Dragon of the Seven Sovereigns; former ally of Morax and guardian of Liyue; sealed
facts.era: ancient (before and during the Archon War) to present
facts.identity_notes: The Chinese localisation calls him an Earth Dragon, the English a Geo Dragon. His benevolent fragment spoke through the artisan Kun Jun; his wrath took the shape of the girl Jiu.

facts.title: Tanit Matriarch
facts.identity_notes: Her family name is Tanit; she is also called 'the Matriarch'. In battle she appears as an Eremite Scorching Loremaster model.

facts.title: Secretary, Jade Chamber
facts.occupation: Secretary to Ningguang, Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing
facts.identity_notes: Chinese name Baishi (Hundred-Knowing); the naming pattern matches fellow secretaries Baiwen (Hundred-Hearing) and Baixiao (Hundred-Understanding).

facts.title: Secretary, Jade Chamber
facts.occupation: Secretary to Ningguang in charge of data collection and organisation
facts.identity_notes: Chinese name Baiwen (Hundred-Hearing); the naming pattern matches fellow secretaries Baishi (Hundred-Knowing) and Baixiao (Hundred-Understanding).

facts.title: Secretary, Jade Chamber
facts.occupation: Secretary to Ningguang, Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing
facts.identity_notes: Chinese name Baixiao (Hundred-Understanding); the naming pattern matches fellow secretaries Baishi (Hundred-Knowing) and Baiwen (Hundred-Hearing). Cousin of Zhenhai, a Millelith guard at the Jade Chamber entrance.

facts.occupation: Physician; former deputy director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
facts.identity_notes: No personal name is given in canon. He appears only in the Lagenaria Chapter (flashbacks and a narrated cinematic) and in other characters' stories.

facts.title: Vahumana Sage
facts.occupation: Sage of the Vahumana Darshan, Sumeru Akademiya
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC. The name echoes the medieval historian al-Baladhuri, per the wiki's etymology note.

facts.title: B; Goddess of Prophecy; Seer-Witch
facts.occupation: Astrologer, diviner and fortune-teller; teacher of Mona
facts.era: At least several centuries old
facts.identity_notes: The wiki-level reading is that 'Megistus' ('great') is a surname-suffix used by mages of her tutelage; she once went by Barbeloth Megistus and renamed herself 'Trismegistus' ('thrice as great') to set herself apart from her students. Mona took the surname Megistus as her student. Her age is never stated; she was at least a young adult when Simulanka was made, and Andersdotter died some time after the Cataclysm.

npc.beisht.name: Beisht
aliases: Final follower of the Overlord of the Vortex

facts.title: The Avenger of the Vortex
facts.identity_notes: Appears in game as a quest boss in the Interlude Chapter (2.4) and the Fleeting Colors in Flight event. The enemy is shown with three heads, each with its own health pool.

facts.title: Snezhnograd Veche Councilor
facts.occupation: Councilor of the Snezhnograd Veche
facts.identity_notes: Russian-style surname (Belozersky; the wiki lists the Russian form as Белозёрский). No given name is stated.

facts.occupation: companion of Jeht
facts.identity_notes: 'Benben' is the name Jeht gave it; its original name or purpose is unknown.

facts.title: Most-Radiant
facts.species: Intelligent construct (artificial intelligence created by King Deshret)
facts.occupation: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars; guardian of the gates of Aaru
facts.era: King Deshret's civilisation (thousands of years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Not a god, human or Jinni: Guiding Notes call him an intelligent construct with a will of his own. He ceased functioning after Deshret's passing and was reawakened in 6.6. Wiki-quoted ancient texts call him the king's 'soul', a bird winging toward the sun.

npc.biram.name: Biram
aliases: Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind

facts.title: Chief of the Masters of the Night-Wind
facts.occupation: Tribal chief and shaman of the Masters of the Night-Wind
facts.identity_notes: Name echoes a Lacandon Maya minor god per the wiki; this is a naming note, not lore. In-game he is only described as unusually tall; no figure is given.

facts.title: Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit
facts.occupation: Cleaner, carrier and combat assistant to Ineffa
facts.identity_notes: A small robot whose earlier names grew with each upgrade.

facts.title: Spring Fairy
facts.identity_notes: Callirhoe is the Spring Fairy of Springvale. She is a water spirit without a lasting body: she can take human form only briefly, otherwise appearing as a water droplet or as the spring itself.

facts.title: The Captain
facts.occupation: First Fatui Harbinger
facts.identity_notes: Il Capitano is his Harbinger codename; Thrain is his personal name. He stops himself from giving the name Thrain and asks to be called just Capitano; Natlan remembers him as the Sentinel Knight, a past he prefers to leave behind.

facts.title: Cardinal
facts.occupation: Cardinal; acting Seneschal of the Church of Favonius
facts.identity_notes: Mentioned only. Barbara's dialogue says he seldom leaves his room, which the archive reads as his working quarters; the Church page lists him only as 'Cardinal'.

npc.chang-the-ninth.name: Chang the Ninth
aliases: Chang the Ninth of Feiyun Slope

facts.occupation: Ore merchant, book collector, novelist
facts.identity_notes: Ninth-born child of the Chang family, which owns a mining business. 'Chang the Ninth' is the name he goes by.

facts.title: Herblord
facts.species: White snake; formerly a giant white snake adeptus
facts.occupation: Healer's companion; former adeptus of Chenyu Vale
facts.identity_notes: 'Changsheng' (longevity) is the name she goes by with Baizhu; the Herblord (Yao Jun) is her old adeptus title. The Chenyu Vale quest 'An Ancient Sacrifice of Sacred Brocade' (4.4) confirms they are the same being.

facts.title: Bartender
facts.occupation: Bartender at Angel's Share
facts.identity_notes: Appears only as the Angel's Share shop NPC, in the World Quest Equivalent Exchange and in two limited-time events.

facts.title: Boss, Wanmin Restaurant
facts.occupation: Chef and owner of Wanmin Restaurant
facts.identity_notes: Xiangling's character stories describe him as a veteran chef with over two decades of experience. No exact age is given.

facts.species: Khaenri'ahn human, immortal by the curse
facts.occupation: Noble of the Alberich Clan; founder of the Abyss Order
facts.era: Khaenri'ah and the centuries after the cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: In the Traveler's memory he used the name Eide, borrowed from a servant he once had.

facts.title: Iskra Manufacturing Plant Boss
facts.occupation: owner and director of the Iskra Manufacturing Plant; wealthy merchant; Veche voter
facts.identity_notes: 'Chugunov' is the only name canon gives; the Russian surname comes from 'chugun', cast iron. Staff address him as Director. Iskra, his daughter's name, is also the name of his plant.

facts.occupation: Doctor and logistics worker, expert in treating Abyssal contamination
facts.identity_notes: Her death is fixed in the Archon Quest; the Record Penned by All lists her among the dead. In the 5.3 Archon Quest she appears only as a spirit who guides the Traveler in a Night Kingdom dream.

facts.species: Human (Byakuyakoku); now a Sinshade (Shade of Tokoyo)
facts.occupation: Female official attending the Sunchildren
facts.era: Byakuyakoku, in the years of the Sunchildren
facts.identity_notes: Her name echoes Clymene, mother of Phaethon in Greek myth, per the wiki's etymology note; the in-game quest name 'The Phaethons' Syrtos' follows the same theme.

facts.title: Scorching Star
facts.occupation: Abyss Lector
facts.identity_notes: The quest names him in the boss fight as 'Comonqui - Scorching Star'. The wiki lists the enemy as Abyss Lector: Fathomless Flames. Whether Abyss Lectors are former humans is not established here.

facts.title: Master Crepus
facts.occupation: Owner and master of the Dawn Winery
facts.vision: none (never obtained a Vision; used a Delusion once)
facts.identity_notes: Mentioned-only NPC (and a character in the official manga); no in-game model. Died about four years before the story begins (some wiki text says about three).

facts.occupation: Flower-Feather Clan member; checks the health of Chasca and Coya per the wiki, further work unstated
facts.identity_notes: Cusco is a quest and web-event NPC with no profile page text; the wiki marks his profile as a stub. His wife is never named.

facts.title: Bough Keeper
facts.occupation: Former Royal Guard captain; Abyss Order hunter
facts.era: Eclipse Dynasty to present
facts.identity_notes: 'Dain' has been his nickname since Khaenri'ah. 'Twilight Sword' was his title as captain of the Royal Guard. 'Bough Keeper' (Chinese: Bough Picker) is his in-game and trailer title; the wiki's reading of 'bough' as Irminsul branches is a guess. He is announced as a future playable character but is not playable as of 7.1.

facts.title: Head Maid
facts.occupation: Head maid of the royal household; personal attendant to the Tsaritsa
facts.identity_notes: Quest NPC introduced in Version 7.0; first shown in the Transcendence trailer 'Sudden Snow' (2026-06-26). Her family name is Postelnitskaya. Her father was a mercenary from Sumeru; her mother and grandmother were court maids.

facts.title: "The Flagship" Bartender
facts.occupation: Bartender and innkeeper; sells food, drinks and recipes
facts.identity_notes: His boss sent him to The Flagship, which he says suits him. His own origin is not stated.

facts.species: Imaginary friend (appears as a small dog)
facts.occupation: Imaginary friend
facts.identity_notes: A quest-exclusive NPC in the Phantasmal Pals event (limited). He exists because Prune imagined him; the wiki lists his location as Inazuma, where the event quest takes place.

facts.pronouns: it (the English quest text uses 'it'; the wiki also writes 'he')
facts.occupation: Juvenile Watcher of the Temple of Space
facts.identity_notes: A child-like, non-human being. It does not use words; treat it as an immature spirit-like Watcher, not a person in disguise. Its name is Latin for 'skillful' or 'right-handed' (a wiki etymology note).

npc.donskoy.name: Donskoy
aliases: the giant of ice and snow

facts.species: Snegovik, altered by the Eitr into a snow giant
facts.occupation: former guard of the Belyi Tsar
facts.era: after the Cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: 'Donskoy' is the name the wiki gives him; in the quests he is called 'the giant' and speaks only as a 'Gentle Male Voice'. The name echoes the Russian knyaz Dmitry Donskoy, a medieval ruler remembered for a famous victory in battle (wiki etymology note). The wiki's 'Returner Who Bound Themselves in Ice - Eitr-Altered Snegovik' is an enemy-type label seen at Pale Crown Palace, not necessarily him.

npc.dottore.name: Dottore
aliases: Exalted Master of the Heretical Path

facts.title: The Doctor
facts.occupation: Second of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers; researcher
facts.era: Born in Sumeru over four centuries before the story; Harbinger for centuries; died in Version 6.6 (Luna VII)
facts.identity_notes: 'Il Dottore' and 'The Doctor' are his Fatui name; Zandik (a Middle Persian word for a heretic) is his given name. The original Zandik died at 85; the in-game figure is the 35-year-old 'Omega Build', one of several independent copies called Segments. 'Dottore' is used for the Segments and the combined figure; the original is 'Zandik'. The wiki also lists Cryo, Electro, Hydro and Pyro as damage types in his boss forms, but no Vision or Delusion is stated.

facts.title: Historian
facts.occupation: Historian and folklore researcher; writing a new book
facts.identity_notes: 'Dr. Edith' is the in-game name; the wiki infobox gives her real name as Edith Musk.

facts.title: Head of the Hunters
facts.occupation: Head hunter of Springvale; meat vendor
facts.identity_notes: Draff is a descendant of Olaf and part of the Kätzlein Bloodline. The name 'draff' is a brewing byproduct, per the wiki's etymology note.

npc.dunyarzad.name: Dunyarzad
aliases: Lesser Lord Kusanali's most faithful follower

facts.occupation: Daughter of the wealthy Homayani family; festival sponsor; acting manager of Puspa Café (as of 6.6)
facts.identity_notes: Quest NPC. Canon calls her a young woman as of Chapter III but gives no age. Her father is Shahzaman; no other family names are given.

facts.title: Anemo Dragon
facts.occupation: Dragon of the East of the Four Winds; guardian of Mondstadt
facts.era: about 2,000 years ago to present
facts.identity_notes: 'Stormterror' was his name while under Abyssal influence; the ruins of Old Mondstadt are still called Stormterror's Lair.

npc.dymov.name: Dymov
aliases: the staff member who went for blankets

facts.title: Theater Staff
facts.occupation: staff member at the Korolevskiy Theater
facts.identity_notes: 'Dymov' is a Russian surname (from 'dym', smoke). The wiki titles him 'Theater Staff'; the quest dialogue calls him a staff member.

facts.title: Former Senior Researcher, Fontaine Research Institute
facts.occupation: Researcher (dismissed)
facts.identity_notes: Held in the Fortress of Meropide as of 4.2; no later appearance found.

facts.title: Teacher
facts.occupation: Fatui instructor; leader of a Fatui cell in Inazuma
facts.identity_notes: 'Snezhevich' is a patronymic ('son of snow') the Fatui give to orphans they raise; it is not a family surname. Lyudochka's counterpart is 'Snezhevna'. His real origins are unknown.

facts.title: Priestess of the "Frostmoon Scions"
facts.occupation: Priestess of the Frostmoon Scions; tends the library
facts.identity_notes: Older sister of Ossian, an adherent of the Scions who also appears in the Frostmoon Enclave. Her dialogue gives her only a short time as a priestess.

facts.title: Receptionist, Northland Bank
facts.occupation: Receptionist at the Northland Bank (Liyue branch); Fatui member
facts.identity_notes: Appears in the Archon Quest 'Guizhong' and as an open-world NPC. No story after 1.x is known to feature her.

facts.title: Scholar of Hilichurlian Linguistics
facts.occupation: Professor of Hilichurlian linguistics (applied grammar of vernacular Hilichurlian)
facts.identity_notes: The wiki notes the Handy Handbook of Hilichurlian's opening note suggests 'Ella Musk' may be a title. Her age is not stated.

facts.occupation: Aquabus guide and operator of the Navia Line
facts.identity_notes: The wiki infobox lists her affiliation as the Marechaussee Phantom; her in-game dialogue never mentions it.

facts.title: The Devouring Benthic Flame; Lavawalker
facts.species: Abyss Lector (human form in disguise); origin unknown
facts.occupation: Abyss Order clerk and researcher of ancient lore
facts.era: possibly the age of the unified civilisations (wiki inference)
facts.identity_notes: 'Enjou' is his first alias. 'Sanka' (5.0), 'Kokuchuu' (5.2) and 'Hayne' (5.8) are aliases; the wiki notes they are puns on the sound of his name in Japanese. His real name is not given, and he asked Citlali to tell him if she finds it.

facts.title: Inspector (formerly)
facts.occupation: Inspector of the Knights of Favonius (former)
facts.identity_notes: Mentioned-only NPC; heard as the 'Cold Voice' in the 6.6 quest A Knight's Resolve. No in-game model. Died by suicide before the story begins.

facts.title: Veche Councillor
facts.occupation: Privy Councillor and Veche Councillor of the Snezhnograd Veche; head of House Trubetskoy
facts.identity_notes: She asks to be called Euphie. 'Ignatyevna' is a patronymic (daughter of Ignatiy).

facts.occupation: Architect; graduate of Kshahrewar
facts.identity_notes: Appears only through other characters, her diary and a voiced narration of that diary; she never speaks on screen.

facts.title: Guardian of the Eternal Oasis
facts.occupation: Guardian of the Eternal Oasis; formerly a servant of Nabu Malikata and King Deshret
facts.era: King Deshret's civilisation (thousands of years ago)
facts.identity_notes: 'Last mother of the Jinn' is an artifact-text epithet. Her original Jinni appearance is unknown; in 3.4 she appears as two orbs floating inside a machine.

facts.title: Kshahrewar Sage
facts.occupation: Sage of the Sumeru Akademiya, head of the Kshahrewar Darshan (mechanics)
facts.identity_notes: Not to be confused with the earlier 'great master Firnas' in the Wings of the Forest glider text, whom that text explicitly distinguishes from the current lecturer.

facts.title: Owner, Floral Whisper
facts.occupation: Florist; owner of Floral Whisper
facts.identity_notes: Not the same person as Motolinia, owner of Floral Whispers in Natlan. Her older sister is the botanist Chloris.

npc.focalors.name: Focalors
aliases: Regina of All Waters, Kindreds, Peoples and Laws

facts.title: God of Justice
facts.species: God (Archon); originally an Oceanid made human by Egeria
facts.occupation: Hydro Archon of Fontaine (hidden inside the Oratrice)
facts.vision: none (held the Hydro Gnosis and the Hydro Archon's Authority)
facts.era: Hydro Archon from the cataclysm (about 500 years ago) until Version 4.2
facts.identity_notes: The real Hydro Archon. Publicly, 'Focalors' was played for about five centuries (the wiki counts 499 years) by Furina, her separated human body and spirit; the regnal title 'Regina of All Waters, Kindreds, Peoples and Laws' was used by Furina in that role. Furina called her 'Mirror-me'. English voice lines pronounce the name roughly 'FOH-sə-lor'.

facts.title: Alder Knight
facts.occupation: Captain of the Knights of Favonius (formerly Commander)
facts.identity_notes: Mentioned-only NPC; no in-game model or voice lines. 'Alder Knight' is the title used in the Gunnhildr's Legacy outfit text and by younger knights.

facts.species: Golden carp; adeptus (can take a human form)
facts.occupation: Adeptus of Chenyu Vale; keeper of the Rainjade Rite
facts.identity_notes: She is a carp in her original form and a young-looking woman in human form. The title 'Fujin of the North' is on the wiki's infobox citing Xianyun's second Character Story; not read directly.

npc.furiosa.name: Furiosa
aliases: Guardian of What Is No More

facts.occupation: archer and guardian of Okurov
facts.identity_notes: Appears in the Local Legend version as 'Furiosa - Guardian of What Is No More' and in the quest as 'Furiosa - Lingering Guardian'; her in-game Valiant Chronicles description calls her a Volkodlak archer. The name echoes the film character Imperator Furiosa (wiki trivia).

facts.title: The Knave's Subordinate
facts.occupation: Fatui Oprichnik in Arlecchino's unit
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC. The wiki's trivia note says his name matches that of a medieval Grand Duke of Lithuania; canon makes no connection.

npc.goth.name: Goth
aliases: Boss of the Goth Grand Hotel

facts.title: Boss, Goth Grand Hotel
facts.occupation: Owner and manager of the Goth Grand Hotel and the Dawn Breeze Inn; landlord of several city properties
facts.identity_notes: Goth is the family name; Ludwig is his given name, and friends in the city call him Goth.

facts.title: God of the Stove
facts.species: God (greatly diminished); small orange panda-like form
facts.occupation: Xiangling's cooking companion; formerly the God of the Stove
facts.era: Archon War era (as Marchosius)
facts.identity_notes: 'Guoba' (scorched rice) is the name Xiangling gave him; 'Marchosius' is his original divine name. The wiki redirects Marchosius to Guoba. The wiki infobox also lists Geo as a former element, reflecting a stove's rock and fire.

facts.title: Wyrdsword of Heaven's End
facts.species: Khaenri'ahn human with the curse of immortality, appearing as an Iniquitous Baptist
facts.occupation: Former swordsmanship instructor; Abyss Order Iniquitous Baptist
facts.element: Abyss (Cryo, Electro, Hydro and Pyro shields in his Baptist form)
facts.era: Khaenri'ah (pre-cataclysm) to present
facts.identity_notes: Wiki lists 'Wyrdsword of Heaven's End' as an Iniquitous Baptist variant later revealed to be Haden.

facts.species: Khaenri'ahn human, cursed into a Black Serpent Knight
facts.occupation: Royal Guard elite; later a cursed Black Serpent Knight
facts.era: Khaenri'ah (pre-cataclysm) to roughly 500 years later
facts.identity_notes: Looks like any Black Serpent Knight: Windcutter; only his conduct sets him apart.

facts.title: Shrine Maiden
facts.occupation: Shrine maiden of the cleansing ritual
facts.identity_notes: The wiki notes her name was 'Kazari' before Version 2.7.

facts.title: Helmsman of the Atlas
facts.occupation: Former pirate helmsman; later caravan member; fugitive posing as a hermit
facts.identity_notes: Not the hermit Derwent, whose identity he took; the 'Atlas' here is the pirate ship, not the Skyward Atlas catalyst.

npc.hertha.name: Hertha
aliases: Logistics Captain of the Knights of Favonius

facts.title: Coordinator, Knights of Favonius; Captain of the 6th Company
facts.occupation: Knights of Favonius captain in charge of logistics (baggage train, resource management, record-keeping); Mondstadt Reputation advisor
facts.identity_notes: In Paralogism a different being took her form; the real Hertha is the one with a long scar on her left forearm.

facts.title: Goat King, Minister of Ministers
facts.species: God (once defeated by King Deshret); anthropomorphic, ram- or goat-headed
facts.occupation: Chief of King Deshret's Seven Pillars; deputy-king of Deshret's desert civilisation
facts.era: Archon War era (served King Deshret); freed from Aaru in 6.6
facts.identity_notes: Goat King is his title; Heryshaf is the name given in the Guiding Notes. Thoth teases him as 'Goatie'. Voice actors: Kaiser Johnson (EN), Luo Yukun (CN), Okai Katsunori (JP), Kim Myung-jun (KR).

npc.hiiragi-chisato.name: Hiiragi Chisato
aliases: Young Lady of the Hiiragi Clan

facts.occupation: Young lady of the Hiiragi Clan; figurehead of the Kanjou Commission after her father's imprisonment
facts.identity_notes: A different person from the Hiiragi clan's historical members; she is the daughter of Shinsuke.

facts.title: Kanjou Commissioner
facts.occupation: Kanjou Commissioner (former); head of the Hiiragi Clan (former)
facts.identity_notes: Detained after the Fatui plot in Inazuma unravelled; his daughter Chisato became acting head of the clan.

facts.title: Engineer
facts.occupation: Mechanic and engineer
facts.identity_notes: Do not confuse with Aino herself or with Ineffa; his wife and child are unnamed.

facts.title: The Wise
facts.species: Khaenri'ahn human, later an Abyss-empowered Sinner
facts.occupation: Universitas President; Chief Royal Mage
facts.era: Eclipse Dynasty, before the cataclysm
facts.identity_notes: 'Hroptatyr' is a name of Odin in Norse myth (per the wiki's etymology note). The Sinner's later whereabouts are unstated; the weapon appearance Ardent Storm says a claymore of that form was once named Starkuthr.

facts.title: 76th Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
