facts.occupation: Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor and spellcaster of the Wangsheng arts (deceased)
facts.identity_notes: Never given a personal name; the game's quest text lists him as 'Hu Tao's Father' (and as 'Father' in dialogue). His surname is Hu through the Hu family line.

facts.title: Knight of Favonius
facts.occupation: Knight of Favonius on street patrol; also restocks and dispenses medicine with Swan
facts.identity_notes: Schmidt is the family name; Huffman is his given name. The Schmidt family has several Knights.

facts.title: Secretary, Yuehai Pavilion
facts.occupation: Secretary of the Liyue Qixing at Yuehai Pavilion
facts.identity_notes: Chinese name Huixin. Not to be confused with Huixing of the Crux Fleet. Her daughter, also a Yuehai Pavilion secretary, is never named.

facts.title: Ruler of Time
facts.species: Shade; a god created by the Heavenly Principles
facts.occupation: Ruler of Time; holder of the Authority of Time
facts.era: Since the Heavenly Principles first arrived on Teyvat
facts.identity_notes: Kairos and Tokoyo Ookami are the Enkanomiya names (2.4), where a scribe writes her true, secret name once, in reverse: Htoratsi. The name Istaroth is used openly from 5.7 onward. The Frostmoon Scions of Hyperborea call her Laimelea, Mother of Time.

facts.title: Yoriki
facts.occupation: Former Soushu of the Iwakura Art; sword instructor for the Kujou Clan
facts.identity_notes: Mitsunari is the corrected romanisation of his name; his swordsman name Kouin was based on the original romanisation 'Kouzou'. Kouin names an era of the school alongside 'Eiin'.

facts.title: Mirror of the Dawning Morn
facts.occupation: Eleventh of the Thirteen Sovereign Lords
facts.era: Natlantea (dragon era), more than 2,000 years ago
facts.identity_notes: Wiki lists the formal designation 'Type-L Self-Regulating Overseer Array Integrated Processing Unit' and CL-11. The name uses Mayan elements; 'Ix' marks a female title. The benevolent half lives on as Ineffa.

facts.title: Narzissenkreuz Artificial Apostle
facts.occupation: Narzissenkreuz Ordo co-founder
facts.identity_notes: Born Jakob Baker, over 500 years ago.

facts.title: Agent - Incinerating Blades
facts.occupation: Fatui Pyro Agent, Debt Collection division, assigned to Liyue Harbor
facts.identity_notes: Named after Inspecteur Javert of Les Miserables (wiki trivia). His fight name in Xingqiu's quest is 'Fatui Javert - Agent - Incinerating Blades'. Non-Chinese voice lines lack the usual Agent voice distortion because they were recorded in the Closed Beta (wiki trivia).

facts.title: Treacherous Grit
facts.occupation: Former Eremite (Tanit, then Thutmose); desert guide and bodyguard on Tirzad's expedition
facts.identity_notes: In the Golden Slumber series he is a living companion; the 6.6 Archon Quest shows only his freed soul.

facts.occupation: Mercenary; leader of her own mercenary band
facts.identity_notes: Signed herself Jeht Tanit while with the Tanit tribe; on breaking with Babel she declared her mother's name, Ufairah Hindi, her own and named herself Jeht Ufairah Hindi. She is young by canon description but no age is stated. Not playable; a quest NPC with a TCG companion card and an avatar.

facts.species: Manifestation of the dragon Azhdaha's wrath (appears as a young girl)
facts.identity_notes: Jiu (A-Jiu) is a form of Azhdaha, not a human child. She looks like a young girl but speaks of ancient events as one who lived them; handle her factually and non-sexually.

facts.title: The Doctor's Subordinate
facts.occupation: Fatui Oprichnik
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC. Called an Oprichnik by the wiki and 'a Fatui soldier' in the quest script.

facts.title: Kaiyang of the Liyue Qixing
facts.occupation: Member of the Liyue Qixing (Kaiyang seat)
facts.identity_notes: The Kaiyang is a seat title (Mizar), not a personal name. The holder's name, gender and portfolio are not given in canon. Some players assume a military portfolio; canon does not say so.

facts.occupation: Treasure Hoarder
facts.identity_notes: A minor thief; do not confuse with Ihanti, the victim.

facts.title: Fatuus
facts.occupation: Fatui Electro Cicin Mage, Ninth Company
facts.identity_notes: Katya is her nickname. Not the Nod-Krai shop NPC Katya, Ekaterina or Katheryne.

facts.title: Receptionist, Adventurers' Guild
facts.occupation: Adventurers' Guild receptionist
facts.identity_notes: There are multiple identical Katherynes, one per branch. It is unknown whether they share a will or memories. Her puppet nature was confirmed by Nahida in the Sumeru Archon Quest, and her maker by Sandrone in Nod-Krai.

facts.title: Boss of Speranza
facts.occupation: Owner of Speranza; retired Treasure Hoarder adventurer
facts.identity_notes: The shop NPC; the wiki separately notes a quest NPC nicknamed Katya, Katarina. Do not conflate the two.

facts.title: Haravatat Sage (former)
facts.occupation: Former sage of the Haravatat Darshan, Sumeru Akademiya
facts.identity_notes: His name is a Persian title meaning 'lord, master'. In the Sabzeruz Festival quests his lines are credited to '???'.

facts.title: Perfumer
facts.occupation: Former perfumer (as 'Edgar'); teacher of perfumery
facts.identity_notes: 'Edgar' was the identity he took in Sumeru; the real Edgar was a Fontainian perfumer whose fate Emilie suspects Kirya sealed. The wiki infobox lists Snezhnaya and Fontaine as his regions and a former Fatui affiliation.

facts.title: Forsaker of the True Way
facts.species: Abyss Herald (formerly a human of Khaenri'ahn descent)
facts.occupation: Priest of the Dark Hollow; Abyss Herald; formerly a ranger of the Order of Skeptics
facts.identity_notes: In-game he is fought as an Abyss Herald: Wicked Torrents (a Hydro enemy). Zurvan describes the human he once was as a Skeptic sent to supervise an Akademiya expedition several hundred years ago.

facts.title: Goddess of the Dawnstar
facts.species: Angel (first of the Angels, created by the Heavenly Principles); now described as a god
facts.occupation: Former Archangel of Celestia and divine envoy to Hyperborea; co-ruler of Hyperborea
facts.era: Unified civilization (about 6,000 years ago) onward
facts.identity_notes: Mentioned only; she has never appeared on screen as a speaking character as of 7.1, though the Ancient Handwriting at the Royal Court of the Seelie preserves her own first-person words. Her rank is given as Archangel or 'Angel of Angels' in different texts.

npc.koshchei.name: Koshchei
aliases: Thing That Used to be Nastya

facts.title: The Deathless
facts.occupation: Bio-alchemist of Hvergelmir
facts.era: Before and around the cataclysm; the Perfect Tree rite in Okurov remains active in the present day
facts.identity_notes: Koshchei is the name; 'Doctor Moreau' is the alias he used in Okurov. In 7.0 he appears only as a presence speaking through Nastya's body. Quest-exclusive NPC with no voice-over or profile page.

facts.title: Proxy Clan Head
facts.occupation: Tenryou Commission official; provisional head of the Kujou Clan
facts.identity_notes: Not to be confused with his elder brother Masahito or with the Takatsukasa Clan, which tried to displace the Kujou.

facts.title: Shogunate Officer
facts.occupation: Officer and general of the Shogun's Army
facts.identity_notes: Elder brother of Kamaji; not to be confused with the clan's namesake Kujou Shigeyori.

facts.title: Tenryou Commissioner (former)
facts.occupation: Former Tenryou Commissioner; head of the Kujou Clan (removed)
facts.identity_notes: A quest-exclusive NPC. 'Takayuki' is his personal name; the Kujou family name comes first in the Inazuman style.

facts.title: Theater Staff
facts.occupation: Korolevskiy Theater staff member (ticket and security checks, duty logbook)
facts.identity_notes: Appears as a living man in the real theater; the 'deaths' of Kulish take place in the Curse of Death dream that everyone wakes from. Whether he is simply presumed alive after the awakening is not stated.

facts.occupation: Eremite mercenary; leader of the Dakan Al-Ahmar brigade
facts.identity_notes: Quest-only NPC; seen in flashback and in the letter and cane he left behind in Sincerity's Facade (3.5). His name may be inspired by the 7th-century Berber ruler Kusaila, whose successor was Dihya (wiki etymology note; not canon).

facts.title: Branch Master, Adventurers' Guild
facts.occupation: Branch Master of the Liyue Adventurers' Guild; formerly a mercenary
facts.identity_notes: The wiki lists her Chinese name as Lan-jie ('Sister Lan'), which she prefers. Her full name Huo Lanling is stated in the Great Expeditionist Challenge (7.0) dialogue.

facts.title: Head of the Lan clan
facts.occupation: Head of the Lan clan of thaumaturges
facts.identity_notes: Lan Yan's uncle. Descended from a brother of the Wind Reader, Lan Junming (the middle of three brothers).

facts.title: Mother of the Jinn
facts.species: Jinni (elemental spirit born from water lilies)
facts.occupation: Jinni; servant of Nabu Malikata, then King Deshret
facts.era: Ancient Sumeru, age of the vassal kings
facts.identity_notes: Also spelled Liloufar (the only place that spelling appears is the older book The Tale of Shiruyeh and Shirin). In the present day she appears as a magic bottle with a floating orb of light; her true body is not shown.

npc.lingyuan.name: Lingyuan
aliases: Beastlord of the Sunken Jade Realm

facts.title: Beastlord of the Sunken Jade Realm
facts.occupation: Mountain lord of Chenyu Vale
facts.identity_notes: Little Mao calls her 'Bluey'. 'Mountain Lord' is a title for the suanni leader in Chenyu Vale legends. In combat she appears as the Solitary Suanni boss with darker blue fur.

facts.occupation: Companion of Linnea
facts.identity_notes: Unlike most blue Jack Frosts she has an earthen, yellow-brown colouring.

facts.title: Doctor
facts.occupation: Doctor
facts.identity_notes: Her species is not stated; she says she is used to treating human patients but also treats fae and animals. Her residence is inferred from her being fetched in Snezhnograd for a house call.

facts.occupation: Companion and guide; familiar of Columbina
facts.identity_notes: Characters first call a luonnotar a blessing of the Moon Goddess; Columbina later reveals this one came from her own soul.

facts.title: Fatui Diplomat
facts.occupation: Fatui diplomat stationed in Mondstadt
facts.identity_notes: Open-world NPC. Wears the standard female Fatui uniform and mask, with pale pink hair. The wiki lists her as from Snezhnaya (region) and stationed in Mondstadt; her EN voice actor is not credited.

facts.title: Shrine Maiden
facts.occupation: Shrine maiden at the Grand Narukami Shrine; former Fatui spy
facts.identity_notes: 'Lyudochka' is the Fatui-given name; 'Snezhevna' is a patronymic the Fatui give to orphans. Momoyo first used 'Gendou Ringo' as a cover; Lyudochka took the name permanently.

facts.title: Rossum Workshop Researcher
facts.occupation: Researcher; operates the Rossum Workshop forge and shop
facts.identity_notes: Name is Russian for 'cradle' or 'swing'. The wiki infobox calls her 'Rossum Workshop Researcher'. Her father is the smith Arkhyp.

facts.title: Streetward Rambler
facts.occupation: Adeptus living as an elderly resident of Liyue Harbor; horticulturist and teacher
facts.era: Archon War to present
facts.identity_notes: Madame Ping (Ping Laolao) is the elderly persona; Streetward Rambler is her adeptus title. The wiki gives her origin as the Guili Assembly, over 3,700 years ago; canon text does not give an exact age.

facts.title: Heir of the legendary Reed Miller (self-proclaimed)
facts.occupation: Conch Gang member; self-styled master thief
facts.identity_notes: Name is Finnish/Basque; surname Veliu is Albanian per the wiki. The Conch Gang normally accepts only children and expels members at a certain age, and Maite tells the Traveler they are too old to join, so she is portrayed as a young person; canon gives no age.

facts.occupation: Painter
facts.identity_notes: Her token is a clockwork relay module that belonged to Seymour, a damaged Recon Log Mek: Elynas's flesh formed around it when she was born.

npc.marcel.name: Marcel
aliases: Marcel of the Confrerie of Cabriere

facts.occupation: Businessman; leader of the Confrerie of Cabriere; producer of Sinthe
facts.identity_notes: Marcel is an assumed identity. His real name is Vacher; the first name was taken from a name circled in his lover Vigneire's list of baby names. There is also a separate event NPC called Marcel in Mondstadt.

facts.title: Boss, Cat's Tail
facts.occupation: Owner of The Cat's Tail tavern; keeps cats
facts.identity_notes: Her nickname 'Dame Workshy the Absentee Boss' is the wiki's record of her Four Drunkards title; the Traveler gets four Mondstadt Grilled Fish when she first chats.
Not the human Mary-Ann Guillotin and not Lyris; a distinct hybrid who carries both sets of memories. The human is a separate entity (historical.mary-ann-guillotin).

facts.occupation: Doctor
facts.identity_notes: Her survival depends on the player's choices in The Surging Darkness (5.1): she appears only if the 'Under Siege' hotspot is chosen and she is rescued.

facts.title: World-Watch Sentry
facts.occupation: Watcher of the Temple of Space; its self-appointed enforcer after Asmoday left
facts.identity_notes: Watcher of Melancholy. He appears only in the 6.5 World Quest series 'A Long Day in the Mountains' and has not been seen since.

facts.species: Human (consciousness became an Oceanid after death)
facts.occupation: Butler and attendant to Navia
facts.identity_notes: Dissolved by Primordial Sea water during Deluge of Wrathful Waters (4.2) while helping evacuate Poisson.

facts.title: Fatui Diplomat
facts.occupation: Fatui diplomat stationed in Mondstadt
facts.identity_notes: Open-world NPC. White-gray hair, standard male Fatui uniform and mask. English voice: Mark Jacobson (per the wiki).

npc.mitya.name: Mitya
aliases: Specialist of the Royal Energy Commission

facts.title: Specialist, Royal Energy Commission of Snezhnaya
facts.occupation: Energy researcher; Project Mistilteinn specialist
facts.identity_notes: Not playable as of 7.1; the wiki lists him as an upcoming playable character. Re-prefix to character if he is released later.

npc.moon-carver.name: Moon Carver
aliases: Perfected Lord who Carves the Moon and Builds the Sun

facts.occupation: Adeptus, disciple of Rex Lapis
facts.identity_notes: Houzhang is the human alias he uses in Liyue Harbor. His full Chinese title translates as the Perfected Lord who Carves the Moon and Builds the Sun.

facts.title: Mountain Shaper
facts.occupation: Adeptus guarding Mt. Hulao
facts.identity_notes: His human alias is Jiehu (a young man with glasses, dark-brown hair and a red streak). Wiki records his Chinese title as Lishui Dieshan Zhenjun, 'the Perfected Lord who guides the waters and shapes the mountains'; the mountain's name means 'Amber-Prison Mountain'.

npc.mr-nine.name: Mr. Nine
aliases: Author of Flowers for Princess Fischl
Author of Legend of the Shattered Halberd

facts.occupation: Ghostwriter and watcher for Nicole; the pen name of a famous author
facts.identity_notes: 'Mr. Nine' is a male pen persona with invented traits such as a receding hairline. The real Mr. Nine is a female Seelie, not Chang the Ninth.

facts.title: Chief, Flower-Feather Clan
facts.occupation: Chief of the Flower-Feather Clan
facts.identity_notes: Open-world NPC in the Flower-Feather Clan (Tlalocan). Described on the wiki as tall; no height is given.

facts.title: Ruler of Life
facts.occupation: Ruler of Life; governs the laws of life under the Heavenly Principles
facts.era: Created when the Heavenly Principles first came to Teyvat, thousands of years ago
facts.identity_notes: Her heart was devoured by Rhinedottir, and her power and consciousness merged into Rhinedottir's body. She has no body of her own; only a shadow behind Rhinedottir's.

facts.title: Amurta Sage; the Grand Sage
facts.occupation: Sage of the Amurta Darshan and Grand Sage of the Sumeru Akademiya
facts.identity_notes: A quest-exclusive NPC. The name is generally read as derived from the polymath Ibn al-Nafis (a wiki etymology note, not an in-game statement).

facts.title: Vijnanapati
facts.occupation: Order leader; scholar
facts.identity_notes: Before the Traveler is formally introduced he appears as '???' at the Order's camp near the Temir Mountains.

facts.title: "Podvorye Restaurant" Owner
facts.occupation: Owner of Podvorye Restaurant
facts.identity_notes: Appears with the same model as a Volkodlak Lobber. He says the restaurant is Volkodlak-founded and Volkodlak-run; his full name and age are not stated. His residence is the restaurant only in the sense that he works there.

facts.title: World-Watch Sentry
facts.occupation: Fallen Watcher of the Temple of Space; waits at Windrest Peak for a helper
facts.identity_notes: Watcher of Nothingness. The Open-Eyed is the title of his world-boss form; the in-game Archive lists him as Watcher: Fallen Vigil. The wiki calls him a Celestia former affiliate.

facts.title: Starshyna
facts.occupation: Starshyna (leader) of the Lightkeepers
facts.identity_notes: Character stories call him a middle-aged man who is 'at most' middle-aged despite being called 'old man' by his troops; no age is given. Early in 6.3 he calls himself 'an ordinary Ratnik' when meeting the Traveler.

facts.title: Wander-Witch
facts.occupation: Travelling witch of the Hexenzirkel; creator of Miliastra Wonderland
facts.identity_notes: Known only by text. A Manekin item calls her 'a witch who uses the pseudonym Octavia', so the name may not be her original one; do not assume otherwise.

npc.old-hu.name: Old Hu
aliases: 75th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor

facts.title: 75th Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
facts.occupation: Director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
facts.identity_notes: Known only as Old Hu; his given name is not stated. Appears in canon as a spirit at the border between life and death.

npc.osial.name: Osial
aliases: That Which Lies in the Deep

facts.title: Overlord of the Vortex
facts.species: Ancient god; sea monster (appears as a five-headed hydra of water)
facts.era: Archon War (about two thousand years ago)
facts.identity_notes: The Chinese title uses the term for the pre-Seven 'demon gods', which English localisation renders 'Overlord' here. His second title, 'That Which Lies in the Deep', appears in Madame Ping's dialogue in The Realm Within (Archon Quest, 1.0) and in the Monolith Fragment and Vortex Vanquisher texts. Osial himself has no dialogue; everything said about him comes from others.

npc.pacal.name: Pacal
aliases: Chief of the Children of Echoes

facts.title: Chief, Children of Echoes
facts.occupation: Chief of the Children of Echoes
facts.identity_notes: Open-world NPC. His Tepetlisaur companion is named Uchu. The wiki infobox lists the element Geo; canon text does not say what that refers to.

facts.title: Best Guide in Teyvat
facts.pronouns: she/her (refers to herself in the third person as 'Paimon')
facts.species: Unknown; a creation of Celestia (per Ronova and Pierro); 'basically a human' on a medical level
facts.occupation: The Traveler's guide and travel companion; adventurer
facts.identity_notes: Formerly of Celestia (severed ties). Pierro's account means she is at least five hundred years old, though her memories cover only the last few years. Residence is where she and the Traveler lodge in Snezhnograd as of 7.1; she travels wherever the Traveler goes.

facts.title: Regrator
facts.occupation: President of the Northland Bank; Fatui Harbinger
facts.identity_notes: Pantalone and Regrator are Harbinger codenames. Named in-game from 1.0 (Goth) and shown in promotional shorts (A Winter Night's Lazzo, The Final Gift); first on screen in an Archon Quest in 6.6.

facts.title: Grand Duchess of the Snegurochka
facts.occupation: Grand Duchess; former Hvergelmir alchemist
facts.era: Pre-Cataclysm to 7.0
facts.identity_notes: Also titled Guardian of the Hesperides. No height is given. EN voice: Kate Clarke.

facts.title: Svetloledovka Resident
facts.identity_notes: One of the five trapped people in the Prime Ice cavern. Sandrone calls the trapped people 'miners'; Pevtsova's own occupation is not stated.

facts.occupation: Director of the Fatui
facts.identity_notes: Born Eftirvit; Pierro is the name he took when the Fatui began. Age unstated; immortal and over 500 years old.

facts.occupation: Fatui officer in charge of Kresnik Kristall deliveries to Sretomorozsk
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC. The wiki links his name to the real-world Mykhailo Polonsky, a Red Army soldier and conspirator, as an etymology note only.

npc.ptashka.name: Ptashka
aliases: the girl in the Korolevskiy Theater
the little ghost of the theater

facts.species: Human soul (deceased); physical form follows the memory of her sickly body
facts.era: An earlier time, when Frostblight was still incurable (the cure came later, announced by 'the Jester' of the Fatui per Chugunov); the year is never given.
facts.identity_notes: Ptashka is the name she gives at the end of Wraith's Nocturne. For most of the quest she answers to 'Tonia'. Her name is a Russian diminutive for a small bird, used affectionately.

facts.title: The Rooster
facts.occupation: Fifth Harbinger; Mayor of Snezhnograd and Glupov; Speaker of the Veche
facts.identity_notes: Pulcinella and The Rooster are codenames; Mirko Radovidovich Veleshek is his personal name. Domovoy are short; he is about a head taller than other Domovoy. Teucer calls him 'Grandpa Pulcinella'.

npc.pulonia.name: Pulonia
aliases: Prospective Undulation Localized Observing and Investigating Automaton

facts.full_name: Prospective Undulation Localized Observing and Investigating Automaton
facts.species: Automaton (large humanoid clockwork construct with Ruin Machine-style design motifs)
facts.occupation: Companion and attendant automaton of the Harbinger Sandrone; originally a measuring/calculating machine
facts.identity_notes: Destroyed in Descending Moon (6.3). Sandrone stores the damaged body at her and Alain's old home and tries to restore the core without erasing his memory of her. Wiki and Sandrone's story text use both 'he' and 'it'.

facts.occupation: Eremite faction leader
facts.identity_notes: An open-world NPC located in the Land of Upper Setekh. The wiki notes the page lacks a full in-game profile.

facts.title: Theater Staff
facts.occupation: Staff member at the Korolevskiy Theater (announcements and event hosting)
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC. Her photo entry in the Traveler's inventory marks her deceased at the start of Winter's Mysterious Silence. Her place of residence is inferred from the theater's location.

facts.title: Forest Watcher
facts.occupation: Forest Watcher
facts.vision: Dendro (granted at the end of Aranyaka)
facts.identity_notes: Quest-only NPC. Wiki notes say she is the first NPC to show a Vision on screen.

facts.title: Poruchik
facts.occupation: Poruchik overseeing the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
facts.vision: Delusion (Pyro, per the wiki infobox; also lists Electro)
facts.identity_notes: Appears as the Local Legend 'Raskolnikov - Poruchik' after the world quest, fighting as a Battle-Hardened Fireblade Shock Trooper.
'Hilda' is her nickname. Her tombstone at the sanatorium is empty.

facts.title: Rächer of Solnari
facts.species: Khaenri'ahn human, empowered by Abyssal power
facts.occupation: Former intelligence officer of the Eclipse Dynasty; Master of the Wild Hunt
facts.era: Khaenri'ah before the Cataclysm; Nod-Krai after it
facts.identity_notes: The quest enemy form is named Blasphemy Against Death.

facts.title: Gold
facts.occupation: Alchemist; Sage-Witch; Ruler of Life (fused with Naberius)
facts.era: Khaenri'ah's final years to the present
facts.identity_notes: Early Breeze Amidst the Forest text used male, then neutral, pronouns for Gold; later canon presents her as a woman.

facts.title: Ruler of Death
facts.species: God; one of the Four Shades created by the Heavenly Principles
facts.occupation: Ruler of Death, Arbiter of the Heavenly Principles
facts.vision: none (held the Authority of Death until Celestia revoked it in 7.1)
facts.identity_notes: Usually called the Ruler of Death; she rejects 'Grim Reaper' as a tired cliche. The Frostmoon Scions knew her as Tuonetar, Mother of the Underworld. Her 7.1 boss titles were 'Arbiter of the Heavenly Principles' and, after losing her authority, 'Paralogism's Outcast'.

facts.occupation: Alchemist-astrologer
facts.era: Cataclysm, 500 years ago
facts.identity_notes: 'The Professor' is the quest-NPC name; 'mad monk' was the nobles' private nickname; 'undying serpent' and 'undying fiend' come from the Aila prophecy and later speakers. He died his first death to Alia and was destroyed for good in The Last Night, the First Light (6.3).

facts.title: Parchamdar of the Corps of Thirty
facts.occupation: Parchamdar (commander) of the Corps of Thirty
facts.identity_notes: Supposedly from the rainforest, not the desert, per Sekkura. 'Youngest Parchamdar in Corps history' is the wiki's and Sekkura's claim; his age is not given.

facts.title: Haravatat Sage
facts.occupation: Sage of the Haravatat Darshan, Sumeru Akademiya
facts.identity_notes: His name echoes Ibn Rushd (Averroes) in the wiki's etymology note, not a canon statement.

facts.occupation: priest's child; ceremonial sacrifice
facts.era: the Tsurumi Island civilization, thousands of years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Described in quest text and the wiki as a child or boy; no age is stated. Japanese name ルー, Chinese name 阿瑠.

facts.title: Samail the Straight Shooter
facts.occupation: Leader of an Eremite band in Thutmose; formerly of the Tanit
facts.identity_notes: In-game he uses the model of an Eremite Sunfrost. Thutmose is an Eremite faction, not a place.

facts.title: Branch Master, Adventurers' Guild
facts.occupation: Branch Master of the Adventurers' Guild's Nod-Krai branch
facts.identity_notes: Referred to as a man ('Mr. Sarin'). He recalls hearing the first stories of Lan's career as a troublesome small child pestering his mother for Midsommar torte; no age is given. In event battles he uses a heavy crossbow.

facts.title: Successor of J
facts.occupation: Traveler; successor to the title of the Hexenzirkel's J
facts.identity_notes: Event NPC from Windblume's Breath. She says she was born in a distant land; the wiki's infobox lists Snezhnaya as her region, which the quest dialogue does not state. She is not a Hexenzirkel member.

facts.occupation: Noble of the Lawrence Clan
facts.era: Present day of Mondstadt (Version 1.5 story)
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC of Eula's Story Quest 'The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea'. He was taken into Knights' custody at the end of that quest; canon does not say what became of him.

facts.occupation: Abyssal servant of Rotwang
facts.era: Cataclysm era (sealed ~500 years ago)
facts.identity_notes: Its original form resembles a larger Evil Eye of Blightseep with a special core and large hands. In battle it appears as a Wilderness Hunter (Nightmare's Avatar) and as a Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares (Pathfinder to the Bedeviled Sky). The wiki uses 'him' once and 'it' elsewhere; the quest text refers to it as 'the monster'.

npc.seamus-pegg.name: Seamus Pegg
aliases: Seneschal of the Church of Favonius

facts.title: Cardinal of Daybreak
facts.occupation: Seneschal of the Church of Favonius; former adventurer
facts.identity_notes: Called 'Simon Page' in the 1.0 English text and renamed 'Seamus Pegg' in 1.4; the same person. Released as a physical open-world NPC at the Cathedral in 6.5. He first appeared (as 'Seamus') in Chapter 1 of the official manga, 'Bad Wine' (2018).

facts.species: Alchemical being in the form of a cat
facts.occupation: Butler to Rhinedottir
facts.identity_notes: Sebas is short for Sebastian, a stereotypical butler's name. Not a normal cat; he speaks, handles vials and can carry a message in a master's voice.

facts.occupation: Front-desk officer and aide at the Palais Mermonia
facts.identity_notes: Referred to as 'Officer Sedene' by the reporter Lepine-Pauline in the limited event Whirling Waltz (5.6).

facts.title: Officer
facts.occupation: Marechaussee Phantom agent (on holiday in Merusea Village)
facts.identity_notes: Open-world NPC with no profile text. Gender, age and appearance are not stated in the dialogue; the wiki page leaves the profile blank.

facts.title: Serpent of All Evils
facts.occupation: Former official of the Belyi Tsar; Abyssal boss
facts.era: Belyi Tsar era
facts.identity_notes: The man was Raimo; the monster is the Serpent.

facts.title: Researcher
facts.occupation: Akademiya scholar and aide to the Grand Sage; later promoter of educational assistance in the desert
facts.identity_notes: The title 'Researcher' is the wiki infobox title for her. The Akademiya affiliation is marked 'formerly' on the wiki; she left with permission in 3.2. Her name is thought to derive from sitara, 'star'; Nahida says it means star.

facts.title: Rtawahist Sage
facts.occupation: Sage of the Rtawahist Darshan, Sumeru Akademiya
facts.era: present day
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC; no voice-over or character story beyond a Guiding Notes entry. His residence is inferred from his post and the evacuation to Caravan Ribat.

facts.title: Most-Holy
facts.species: Intelligent construct (artificial intelligence made by King Deshret)
facts.occupation: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars; overseer of all the Jinn
facts.era: King Deshret's civilisation (thousands of years ago); awakened in 6.6
facts.identity_notes: Not a god, human or Jinni: Guiding Notes call him a construct with a will of his own. An ancient text calls him the king's 'will' and 'a lioness with a human head'. In 6.6 he appears as a hologram; whether he has any other body is not shown. Residence is the Mausoleum or Aaru system (inferred).

facts.title: Liaison Officer
facts.occupation: Liaison between Sretomorozsk's townspeople and the Fatui Kristall delivery
facts.identity_notes: A citizen of Sretomorozsk, not a Fatui member. His claim to have grown up in Alatyr is told in the confrontation scene and contradicted by Alyosha, who is from Alatyr; whether he ever lived there is not stated.

facts.title: Mercenary
facts.occupation: Independent mercenary and bodyguard, usually hired by Snezhnayan nobles
facts.era: More than four hundred years before 7.0

facts.title: All Else Aside, Now a Master of the Mechanical Arts
facts.occupation: Disciple of Xianyun (Cloud Retainer); from a family of exorcists
facts.identity_notes: A child-like young girl; canon gives no age. The wiki infobox lists a title for her (see uncertainties).

facts.title: The Fair Lady
facts.occupation: Fatui Harbinger and diplomat; Odette's mentor
facts.identity_notes: La Signora is the Harbinger identity; Rosalyne-Kruzchka Lohefalter is her personal name. Canon never states in one line that Signora and the Crimson Witch of Flame are the same woman, but the evidence is strong (see uncertainties).

npc.sigurd.name: Sigurd
aliases: The One Who Swore to Hunt the Hunt

facts.title: Starshyna
facts.occupation: Former Starshyna of the Lightkeepers

facts.title: Attendant of the Spina di Rosula
facts.occupation: Attendant and bodyguard to Navia
facts.era: Present day, Fontaine (died in the Deluge of Wrathful Waters, Version 4.2)
facts.identity_notes: Canon calls him the younger of Navia's two attendants; no numeric age is given. No Vision is mentioned in the sources read. After his death his consciousness was forged into an Oceanid.

facts.title: Jade-Plumed Silverwing
facts.species: Adeptus; an Illuminated Beast born of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, manifested as swallows
facts.occupation: Adeptus of the Eight Adepts; in charge of bringing the swallows home to Liyue each year
facts.era: Archon War (roughly a thousand years before the present, as the Wind Reader's story counts it)
facts.identity_notes: Her human form has very long black hair; her bird form is a large sparrow-like swallow with white-and-teal feathers. Her swallow flock is both her living manifestation and the source of her power, so whether the swallows of Liyue today are 'her' is left as a philosophical question by Zhongli.

facts.title: Chief of the Shimti tribe
facts.occupation: chief of the Shimti tribe; self-styled special ambassador of the Akademiya
facts.identity_notes: Appears in memory scenes during Dance of Death: Serpent and Scorpion (Nod-Krai Archon Quest, 6.1). The wiki calls him the last chief of the Shimti.

facts.title: Overmind (of his own Hive)
facts.occupation: Vahumana researcher
facts.identity_notes: 'Overmind' is Alhaitham's term for his role in the Hive. The wiki says he is currently imprisoned; dialogue shows only that he was arrested and taken for trial.

facts.title: Captain of the 3rd Company
facts.occupation: Knight of Favonius; Captain of the 3rd Company
facts.identity_notes: The wiki notes the name echoes Skiron, the Greek wind associated with Athens, and the mythical Sciron.

facts.title: Blood Serpent's Broken Edge
facts.occupation: Swordsman; formerly heir of a noble house
facts.identity_notes: The wiki infobox lists the Eclipse Dynasty as a former affiliation; the quest itself says only that he was the eldest son of a Khaenri'ahn noble family. 'Blood Serpent's Broken Edge' is the title shown on the boss.

facts.title: Chef of Wangshu Inn
facts.occupation: Cook at Wangshu Inn; formerly a thief
facts.identity_notes: Chinese name Yanxiao means 'talk and laugh'. The English 'Smiley' was added by the localisation as a joke, since he is gruff. In his early dialogue he calls himself the inn's sous-chef.

facts.occupation: Private, Fatui 6th Company (on leave)

facts.title: Crocodile King
facts.species: God (a god defeated by King Deshret)
facts.occupation: One of King Deshret's Seven Pillars; Captain of Captains, foremost general
facts.era: King Deshret's civilisation (several thousand years ago); freed in 6.6
facts.identity_notes: Anthropomorphic crocodile-headed god. His full style is Crocodile King Sobek, Captain of Captains. Residence is inferred: after the 6.6 crisis Thoth and Heryshaf stayed at the Temple of Silence, and Sobek presumably joined them but this is not stated.

facts.title: Wealthy Merchant
facts.occupation: Businesswoman; began by selling fashionable cold-weather clothing
facts.identity_notes: In-game her title alternates between 'Wealthy Merchant' and 'Rich Businessman' (Torgov's title); the wiki treats the second as a text slip.

facts.title: Bloomguard of the Pari
facts.occupation: Bloomguard of the Pari
facts.identity_notes: Born after the cataclysm of five hundred years ago, according to Zurvan; no exact age is given. Her honorific for the Traveler, Yasnapati, is a Pari term, and 'Pale Floater' is her name for Paimon.

facts.title: Ratnik; Sergeant Major of the Lightkeepers
facts.occupation: Lightkeeper Sergeant Major
facts.identity_notes: The person who appears alive on screen in Fulminations and Undercurrents is Rerir wearing Sousi's face. The Lightkeepers wiki page lists Sousi among its Sergeant Majors, marked deceased; the infobox calls him a Ratnik and Aino calls him a Ratnik in charge of firing the cannon.

facts.occupation: Adventurer; storyteller
facts.identity_notes: Goes by 'Stanley', the name of the late friend he travelled with; not to be confused with the historical Stanley, who is a separate character.

facts.title: Onyx Agate
facts.occupation: Company commander in the Fatui; formerly Bombardier Poruchik (junior officer) of the 1st Grenadier Guards, 3rd Company
facts.identity_notes: 'Onyx Agate' is his event codename; Stepanyan is his surname. His first name is not given.

facts.title: Spartacus the Righteous
facts.occupation: Leader of the Byakuyakoku resistance
facts.era: Byakuyakoku, thousands of years before the present
facts.identity_notes: Only the Lotus Eater world quest shows him. The name Spartacus is given in the quest and The Byakuyakoku Collection.

facts.title: The Foul
facts.occupation: Former knight; Sinner; wandering warrior and teacher
facts.vision: none (Abyssal power; the Seven-Shifting Serpent mimics all seven Elements)
facts.era: Khaenri'ah and the cataclysm 500 years ago, then the sea of stars
facts.identity_notes: Surtalogi is his name; "The Foul" is his Sinner title. He can take any form and is shown mostly in Abyssal armour with a claymore-like weapon; the Sinner weapon attributed to him, Gusisnautar, is now the bow Starpiercer.

facts.occupation: guard on a special assignment at Podvorye Restaurant
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC. The wiki lists a Fatui affiliation; his own lines say only that he follows Master Childe's orders.

facts.title: "Voynich Guild" Employee
facts.occupation: Manager of the Voynich Guild's souvenir outlet; Guild representative in the League

facts.title: Storyteller
facts.occupation: Storyteller
facts.identity_notes: Name rendered 'Tea Master Liu Su' in game (Chinese title 'Cha Boshi Liu Su', literally tea doctor); called 'Master Liu', 'Dr. Liu' and 'old man Liu' by others.

facts.title: Herring I Captain
facts.occupation: Watatsumi Army soldier; logistics, later captain of Herring I
facts.era: Inazuma Vision Hunt era
facts.identity_notes: Japanese name 哲平. Wiki titles: Herring I Captain, Sangonomiya Samurai.
Per the wiki's etymology note, his name echoes the Greek archer Teucer, half-brother of Ajax the Great (Ajax is Tartaglia's birth name); this is a wiki observation, not a canon statement.

facts.occupation: Trainee medic, Knights of Favonius 8th Company
facts.era: Present day (Version 6.6 story)
facts.identity_notes: Quest NPC of Lohen's 'A Knight's Legacy' (Lepus Miles Chapter, Act I). He was kidnapped as a child with Lohen; both were rescued by Adorno.

facts.title: Fatui delegate
facts.occupation: Fatui delegate to Liyue; Yusupov's second-in-command
facts.identity_notes: Never appears on screen and has no voice, model or dialogue; he is described by other characters. Chinese name Ti'aofan.

facts.occupation: Intelligence officer of the Eclipse Dynasty (hunter of Crimson Moon remnants)
facts.era: Eclipse Dynasty, Khaenri'ah (before the nation's fall)
facts.identity_notes: Appears only as a figure in Rerir's memory fragment, viewed through Nefer's ceremony. The wiki profile is an empty stub; everything here comes from one scene.

facts.title: Ibis King
facts.occupation: Seven Pillar of King Deshret; former Moon Envoy
facts.era: Age of King Deshret
facts.identity_notes: Thoth is his name; Ibis King, Scribe of Scribes and Lord of Lies are titles.

facts.title: Scholar of Alchemy
facts.occupation: Alchemy scholar; assistant to Albedo
facts.identity_notes: The wiki traces the name to Timaeus of Locri, a speaker in Plato's dialogues. Albedo pronounces it 'Timayus'.
Not to be confused with Ptashka, who used the name 'Tonia' during Wraith's Nocturne (7.0). Per the wiki, 'Tonia' is also the name of a character in a storybook in that quest.

npc.torgov.name: Torgov
aliases: the wealthy energy magnate of the Korolevskiy Theater

facts.title: Rich Businessman
facts.occupation: wealthy businessman in the energy industry
facts.identity_notes: Quest-exclusive NPC. The theater group later learn that their souls were drawn into the theater's Ley Lines; Torgov is the first (with Soboleva) found dead in the story, but his nature (long dead or otherwise) is never spelled out.

facts.title: Prince/Princess of the Abyss Order
facts.identity_notes: Which twin this is depends on the player's choice at the start: Aether (male, medium male model) if the player is Lumine, Lumine (female, medium female model) if the player is Aether. The sibling always calls the Traveler by their real name, whatever nickname the player picked, and the twins are the only ones who call each other Aether and Lumine. Titles: Prince/Princess of Khaenri'ah (from King Irmin), Savior (the Khaenri'ahns' hopeful nickname), Prince/Princess of the Abyss Order, and Nara Varuna among the Aranara. No age or height is given in canon. No element or Vision has been shown.

npc.trofin-snezhevich.name: Trofin Snezhevich
aliases: the bad guy in Vimara Village

facts.title: Bad Guy
facts.occupation: Fatui agent posing as an apprentice in Vimara Village
facts.identity_notes: Alphonso is a cover name; his birth name is 'buried in freezing snow', and Snezhevich is the surname the House of the Hearth gave him. He claims to be a Fontainian apprentice who came to Sumeru with his teacher, yet wears Mondstadter-style clothes (wiki observation).

facts.occupation: Cryo Archon; Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya
facts.identity_notes: Anastasya Feodorovna is her name from before her coronation; Snezhnaya is the feminine form of her predecessor's surname Snezhnyi, taken afterwards. Vassaga is her divine name. 'The Tsaritsa' is the title everyone uses. She is not a Fatui Harbinger; she appoints them.

facts.occupation: Hunting dog
facts.identity_notes: A dog; he does not speak and communicates by barking, whining and howling. The wiki notes his name comes from the dragon-like Tugarin of Russian folklore, slain by the hero Alyosha Popovich.

facts.occupation: Knight of Favonius
facts.identity_notes: She has never appeared on screen and has no voice lines; every trait comes from what Thoma and Kaeya say about her.

facts.species: Human in life; now an Abyssal monster
facts.occupation: Supervisor of the Post-Apocalyptic Elysium (formerly)
facts.era: Died around 500 years ago, as a monster about the time of the Cataclysm; reawakened sometime after Rotwang's defeat

facts.title: Tianshu
facts.occupation: Tianshu of the Liyue Qixing; amateur fisherman
facts.identity_notes: 'Tianshu' is the Qixing title (Celestial Pivot, after the first star of the Big Dipper); the commoner name 'Uncle Tian' (Chinese Tianshu) is homophonous with it. His personal name is never given.

npc.valeriy.name: Valeriy
aliases: Commander of the Special Assignments Battalion

facts.title: Fort Fulguration
facts.occupation: Major; commander of the Special Assignments Battalion, Armory Palace Royal Grenadier Guards, First Regiment
facts.identity_notes: The wiki infobox lists a second title, 'Commander of the Special Assignments Battalion'. The wiki shows him as an upcoming playable Electro character with the constellation Ursus Magnus; none of that is released as of 7.1, so no kit, rarity or weapon is recorded here. In the Mr. Door sequence of Winter's Mysterious Silence he is a summonable assist whose charge deals Electro damage (a gameplay representation; no Vision is mentioned in dialogue).

facts.title: Young Sire
facts.occupation: leader of the Izmaylov fae gang
facts.identity_notes: 'Vasiliy Nikolayevich' marks him as Nikolay Izmaylov's adoptive son; Iryna names him 'Vasiliy "Oedipus" Izmaylov', and 'Oedipus' is also the gang's password at the Train Boneyard. In the final fight he rejects both 'Nikolayevich' and 'Young Sire' as names.

facts.title: The Visionary
facts.occupation: Court prophet
facts.era: Eclipse Dynasty
facts.identity_notes: Sinner linked to 'Time'; blinded by King Irmin; known in the present only as a voice and a chained crystal. Weapon is per the Hallowed Fetters weapon-appearance text (once 'Gleipnir').

facts.species: Artificial Fatuus (synthetic being made by Sandrone)
facts.occupation: Fatui reconnaissance agent
facts.identity_notes: Not a playable character and not a Harbinger. Fajeyi and Gulebu, his two subordinates, die alongside him.

facts.title: Acolyte of the Frostmoon Scions
facts.occupation: Priestess of the Frostmoon Scions (formerly worked in Nasha Town)
facts.identity_notes: 'Verna' is her short form; Vernadska is her full name. In-game she introduces herself ceremonially as a High Priestess, which is playful self-promotion; the wiki lists her title as Acolyte, formerly Priestess, of the Frostmoon Scions.

facts.title: Legendary Scout
facts.occupation: Scout and warrior
facts.identity_notes: He is an Ancient Name bearer; the Name itself is never shown, only that it means 'to seek'. His wiki page has no lore, appearance or voice-over entries.

facts.title: Fatui Diplomat
facts.occupation: Fatui diplomat's assistant (logistics and errands)
facts.identity_notes: Introduced as a Mondstadt Favonius Cathedral NPC (1.0), moved to Sumeru City after commissions in 2.4 and 3.0. Lily's nickname for him is 'Mister Fatooey'. He calls himself a diplomat's assistant in dialogue; the wiki infobox title reads 'Fatui Diplomat'.

facts.species: Human (Frostmoon Scion, with antlers by ancestry)
facts.occupation: Frostmoon Scion who served beside the Moonchanter; later Fatui recruit
facts.identity_notes: Formerly of the Frostmoon Scions; the Fatui is her new, self-chosen allegiance. The wiki's etymology note (Guglielma/Wilhelmina of Bohemia) is a name comparison, not lore.

facts.occupation: Former ballerina of the Korolevskiy Theater; ballet teacher to her daughter
facts.identity_notes: Appears only in Odette's Character Stories 3-4, Odette's teaser, and NPC and quest mentions. The wiki lists her as 'Mentioned'.

facts.title: Blacksmith
facts.occupation: Blacksmith; master of Schulz
facts.identity_notes: An open-world NPC (blacksmith) who has been at his forge since release; the smithy is named for his apprentice, not for him.

facts.title: Master of Stars (as Starsnatcher)
facts.occupation: Folklorist and writer; keeper of Pervases' Temple; formerly the false adeptus Starsnatcher
facts.identity_notes: 'Starsnatcher' is the false adeptus persona. In the persona he refers to himself as 'one' and wears a Yaksha-style mask. The Chinese title for the persona is Heavenly Lord Who Picks Up the Stars and Seizes the Celestial Bodies. His name Ping'an means 'peaceful'.
A quest-exclusive NPC with a few lines. The wiki profile is empty apart from his affiliation and fate conditions.

npc.wayna.name: Wayna
aliases: Chief of the Scions of the Canopy

facts.title: Chief, Scions of the Canopy
facts.occupation: Chief of the Scions of the Canopy
facts.identity_notes: Open-world NPC. He asks people not to call him 'Uncle Wayna' because he insists he is not that old; the name is a Quechua word meaning 'young' (wiki etymology note).

npc.ying-er.name: Ying'er
aliases: Shop Assistant of Scent of Spring

facts.title: Shop Assistant, Scent of Spring
facts.occupation: Shop assistant at Scent of Spring (a fine vase shop); perfume maker
facts.identity_notes: Chinese name Ying'er means 'little oriole', a bird of spring and song; the shop name Scent of Spring is Chunxiang Yao ('Spring-Scent Kiln').

facts.title: Lord of the Crossroads
facts.occupation: Ruler of the Night Kingdom
facts.era: Ancient Natlan
facts.identity_notes: 'Yohualtecuhtin' appears only in the English localisation; the original Chinese uses only the title 'Lord of the Night'. Lord of the Crossroads is a title also borne by Columbina (Nocturne's Curtain Call weapon text). She has so far been shown only as a swirl of smoke-like ley line energy; a former winged form is inferred from Angel murals.

facts.title: A Special-Looking Crane
facts.species: Crane that gained sentience (illuminated beast); human in appearance for about fifty years through a potion
facts.occupation: Disciple-in-training of Cloud Retainer; formerly an exorcist's partner who helped Liyue during a drought
facts.identity_notes: Several centuries old as a crane according to the wiki profile; canon text read here gives no exact age. In human form she is an elderly woman who is told she looks younger than her years.

facts.occupation: Gate guard at Glupov
facts.identity_notes: A quest-exclusive NPC. The wiki profile, appearance and affiliation are empty; 'Fatui' comes from the quest's on-screen text calling him an unimpressed Fatui guard. His gender is inferred from the masculine Russian form of his name (Южанин, per the wiki's Russian name); no dialogue states it.

facts.occupation: retired Kshahrewar professor and architect
facts.identity_notes: The wiki infobox lists the title 'Kshahrewar Household Name'; this is not confirmed in the dialogue read. Her name echoes the real-world architect Zaha Hadid, per the wiki.

npc.zarechnaya.name: Zarechnaya
aliases: Acting Chair of the Royal Energy Commission

facts.title: Acting Chair, Royal Energy Commission of Snezhnaya
facts.occupation: Acting Chair of the Royal Energy Commission of Snezhnaya (temporary appointee from Zapolyarny Palace)
facts.identity_notes: An open-world NPC met in Kresnik's Burning Heart beneath Snezhnograd's central plaza. She is not the singer Zarechnaya in the ballet The Seabird, whose name she merely shares.
Nicknamed Lind. Her name combines the German words for time (Zeit) and gentle (lind); her sister's name echoes space (Raum).

facts.title: Firebird
facts.occupation: Guardian of Okurov
facts.era: unknown; the wiki says she stayed in the valley for several centuries
facts.identity_notes: Zhara is the Russian word for 'heat', the first root of Zhar-ptitsa, the Russian Firebird. A derived mass-produced creature, the Immortal Construct, is a separate enemy type.

facts.title: Adventurer
facts.occupation: Adventurers' Guild cartographer
facts.identity_notes: The wiki's series summary for The Chasm Delvers calls her an engineer; her profile and the quests treat her as a cartographer. Her letter says she has no Vision.

facts.occupation: Leader of the Luchkin fae gang; Speaker of the High Table (per wiki)
facts.identity_notes: Surname Luchkin is the gang's name, given by his adoptive father Izmaylov, as with Vasiliy Izmaylov, Iryna Voronina and Lyubov Remusov.

facts.title: The First Pari
facts.occupation: Eldest of the Pari; guardian of the Vourukasha Oasis
facts.identity_notes: The wiki says she was born during the cataclysm 500 years ago. In dialogue she says she woke amid a sea of flowers while the Abyss ravaged Sumeru. Pari eventually become Plumes of Purifying Light and return to the Amrita; canon gives no date for hers.

npc.zver.name: Zver
aliases: Beast of the Pale Star Court

facts.title: The Beast
facts.species: Chimeric Winged Lion (sentient, two-headed bio-alchemical creation)
facts.occupation: Companion of the Belyi Tsar; guardian of his body
facts.era: pre-Cataclysm court of the Belyi Tsar; guarded the palace for 500 years
facts.identity_notes: 'Zver' is the Russian word for 'beast' and the name the Belyi Tsar bestowed. It is a specific sentient individual, not the generic Chimeric Winged Lion boss.

facts.occupation: Fatuus under Sandrone
facts.identity_notes: Zverev appears only in Great Deeds on the Tundra (Archon Quest, Chapter VII Act I, Everwinter Without Mercy). The stage directions call him a Fatuus (a Fatui rank-and-file agent); his rank beyond that and his exact duties are not stated.
